jobs.description:
Fliff is the arena for high-upside play. We are dismantling the paywalls of legacy sportsbooks and reimagining the economics of social games to pioneer the next generation of rewards-driven entertainment spanning sports, casino, predictions, collectibles, and beyond.



Powered by a frictionless freemium architecture, Fliff democratizes access and gives millions of players nationwide a real stake, real thrill, and real upside. By combining authentic competitive drive with instant rewards and interactive games, we are turning passive sports fans and casual gamers into active, empowered participants – unlocking the player in everyone.

As Fliff continues to expand across sportsbook, daily fantasy sports, social gaming, and future gaming experiences, promotions remain one of the most powerful tools for influencing customer behavior, driving engagement, and creating differentiated player experiences.

We’re looking for a Promotions Strategy Manager who understands how incentives influence customer behavior and can help shape the future of promotional strategy at Fliff.

The Role

The Promotions Strategy Manager will help determine what offers Fliff runs, who receives them, how success is measured, and how promotional spend can be optimized to drive customer engagement and long-term value.

This role sits at the intersection of promotional strategy, customer behavior, analytics, competitive intelligence, and operational execution. You will partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Compliance, and VIP teams to develop and optimize promotional programs that support business growth while maintaining sustainable economics.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Lifecycle Marketing.

What You’ll Do

    Develop Promotional Strategy

  • Design customer incentive strategies that support acquisition, engagement, retention, reactivation, loyalty, and monetization objectives

  • Develop promotional concepts, offer structures, and qualification criteria across customer segments

  • Recommend promotional investments based on customer behavior, business objectives, and market trends

  • Identify opportunities for cross-product promotions and new incentive strategies

    • Own Promotional Performance & Economics

  • Evaluate promotional performance and return on investment across offer types and customer segments

  • Analyze redemption behavior, promotional costs, customer response, and offer effectiveness

  • Support promotional forecasting, budgeting, and cost management efforts

  • Measure incrementality and identify opportunities to improve promotional efficiency

  • Help establish best practices around promotional testing and optimization

    • Lead Competitive Intelligence

  • Maintain a constant pulse on promotional activity across sportsbook, fantasy sports, social gaming, social casino, and adjacent industries

  • Track competitor acquisition offers, retention programs, loyalty initiatives, VIP incentives, and event-based promotions

  • Identify emerging trends, opportunities, and risks within the promotional landscape

  • Bring new promotional concepts, mechanics, and customer engagement ideas to the business on a regular basis

    • Manage Promotional Portfolio & Calendar

  • Own Fliff’s promotional calendar and promotional portfolio across products and customer segments

  • Coordinate promotional scheduling across customer segments, business objectives, sporting events, product launches, and enterprise initiatives

  • Manage promotional inventory and offer prioritization across identified segments

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing, VIP, Social and Product teams to ensure successful deployment of promotional initiatives

    • Drive Experimentation & Optimization

  • Design and execute structured testing plans for promotional initiatives in coordination with Analytics

  • Evaluate offer mechanics, incentive values, timing, targeting, and promotional frequency

  • Partner with Analytics teams to measure outcomes and identify optimization opportunities

  • Establish repeatable processes that improve promotional performance over time

What Success Looks Like

    Within your first year, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of Fliff’s promotional performance and customer behavior

  • Establish a consistent competitive intelligence process

  • Improve promotional efficiency and effectiveness across key customer segments

  • Develop scalable promotional planning and governance practices

  • Become a trusted resource for promotional strategy, incentive design, and competitive promotion trends

What We’re Looking For

    Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in promotions, loyalty, CRM, retention marketing, gaming operations, commercial strategy, or related disciplines

  • Experience within sportsbook, fantasy sports, social gaming, social casino, mobile gaming, loyalty programs, or adjacent industries

  • Strong understanding of promotional mechanics, customer incentives, and offer design

  • Experience evaluating campaign performance and customer behavior

  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Analytics, Product, and Finance teams

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, startup environment with a hands-on approach

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with promotional economics, customer segmentation, and incentive optimization

  • SQL proficiency and experience with tools such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar analytics platforms

  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Optimove, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar tools

  • Experience operating within regulated industries

  • Working knowledge of recommendation systems, offer optimization frameworks, and next-best-action decisioning models

  • Familiarity with machine learning approaches such as propensity modeling, uplift modeling, recommendation engines, or Multi-Armed Bandit methodologies

  • Experience partnering with Data Science teams to operationalize predictive models and personalization strategies

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including base salary, benefits, and equity.

  • Unlimited/Flexible paid time off.

  • Health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as generous parental leave.

  • Employee-sponsored 401(k).

    • Extras:

  • $500 work-from-home stipend + Equipment & Accessories.

  • Work Remotely.

  • Opportunity for professional development in a dynamic, global setting.

  • A supportive, collaborative, and knowledge-driven workplace. An engaging and challenging role with the freedom to innovate and develop effective solutions.

We are a multinational company with our headquarters based in Philadelphia, and offices in New York, Austin, and Sofia, Bulgaria. Wherever we are in the world, we pride ourselves on being a close-knit, focused team that is welcoming and friendly, and the work that we do is always interesting and rewarding. About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based performance marketing agency specializing in helping high-growth brands scale through data-driven digital advertising, creative strategy, and emerging commerce channels.

The company works with ambitious eCommerce and direct-to-consumer brands, combining performance media, creative experimentation, analytics, and technology to drive measurable growth. With a strong culture of innovation, testing, and continuous optimization, the team operates at the forefront of rapidly evolving platforms such as TikTok and social commerce.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior TikTok Shop Media Buying Specialist to lead performance and social commerce strategies for high-growth eCommerce brands.

This is a highly specialized role dedicated to the TikTok ecosystem, with a strong focus on maximizing Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) through Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, affiliate content, and TikTok Shop's native commerce tools.

The ideal candidate combines advanced paid media expertise with a deep understanding of how consumers discover and purchase products through TikTok. You should be comfortable managing significant advertising budgets, analyzing performance data, identifying winning creative quickly, and making real-time optimization decisions.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of performance marketing, social commerce, creative experimentation, and emerging technology.

You will have direct exposure to high-growth eCommerce brands and significant advertising budgets while helping shape TikTok Shop strategies in a fast-moving environment where creative thinking, analytical decision-making, and speed to market are critical.

What You’ll Do

TikTok Shop Media Buying

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize Video Shopping Ads (VSA) and Product Shopping Ads (PSA) within TikTok Ads Manager.

  • Develop paid media strategies designed to increase TikTok Shop GMV while maintaining brand-specific profitability targets.

  • Continuously optimize campaign structures, bidding strategies, audiences, budgets, and creative performance.

Livestream & Social Commerce Strategy

  • Manage real-time bidding and traffic orchestration for Live Shopping Ads (LSA) during key brand events.

  • Monitor live campaign performance and make rapid adjustments based on traffic, conversion, inventory, and promotional activity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the relationship between paid media and organic TikTok Shop activity.

Affiliate & Creator Scaling

  • Identify high-performing affiliate content through the TikTok Shop Affiliate Center.

  • Scale winning affiliate content using Spark Ads and GMV Max.

  • Analyze affiliate performance to determine which creators and assets should receive additional paid amplification.

TikTok Shop Management

  • Monitor TikTok Shop Seller Center performance and overall account health.

  • Ensure advertising strategies remain aligned with inventory availability, promotions, product performance, and shop activity.

  • Identify potential operational or performance issues that could impact campaign results.

Creative Testing & Optimization

  • Collaborate closely with creative teams to rapidly test hooks, concepts, transitions, formats, and TikTok-native trends.

  • Use performance data and AI-driven insights to guide creative iteration.

  • Identify winning assets quickly and translate performance learnings into actionable creative recommendations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of TikTok-native content and what drives users from discovery to purchase.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Analyze and report on ROAS, CAC, settled GMV, affiliate performance, and creative effectiveness.

  • Translate TikTok's attribution and commerce data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Use data to identify opportunities for additional growth and improved efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Paid Social Media Buying.

  • At least 1 year of specialized hands-on experience within the TikTok Shop ecosystem.

  • Proven experience managing $100K+ in monthly advertising spend, preferably for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

  • Advanced hands-on experience with:

    • TikTok Ads Manager

    • TikTok Shop Seller Center

    • TikTok Shop Affiliate Center

  • Strong understanding of Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, Spark Ads, and GMV Max.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and optimize campaigns based on GMV, ROAS, CAC, and other performance metrics.

  • Strong Google Sheets skills, including data analysis and modeling.

  • Experience working with TikTok Creative Center.

  • Strong understanding of performance creative and the ability to identify effective hooks, formats, and TikTok-native creative trends.

  • Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills.

  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment.

  • Ability to work PST or EST hours and participate in daily stand-ups and real-time campaign adjustments.

  • High-speed internet connection and a dedicated professional remote workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • TikTok Academy certifications in Media Buying and/or TikTok Shop.

  • Experience with Looker Studio.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative and video iteration tools such as CapCut, Symphony, or generative AI tools.

  • Experience with additional paid media platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Pinterest Ads, or Amazon Marketing Services (AMS).

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Science, Economics, or a related field.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be evaluated based on:

  • Total Shop GMV: Consistent month-over-month growth in settled TikTok Shop revenue.

  • Shop ROAS: Maintaining advertising efficiency above brand-specific profitability thresholds.

  • Affiliate Synergy: Increasing the percentage of revenue generated through successfully amplified affiliate content.

  • Creative Win Rate: Effectively identifying winning creative assets within the first 48–72 hours of testing.

  • Ability to translate performance data into actionable campaign and creative decisions.

  • Speed and effectiveness in adapting strategies as TikTok Shop trends, products, and campaign performance evolve.

Why Join Us

  • Work directly with high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands.

  • Manage meaningful advertising budgets and sophisticated TikTok Shop campaigns.

  • Develop expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of digital commerce.

  • Collaborate with experienced performance marketing, creative, and strategy professionals.

  • Work in an environment that values experimentation, data-driven decision-making, innovation, and speed.

  • Build strategies that directly influence revenue and measurable business growth.

Important Notes

  • This role is specifically focused on TikTok Shop and social commerce. Candidates should have direct, hands-on TikTok Shop experience rather than only general paid social experience.

  • Candidates must be comfortable working with significant advertising budgets and making performance-driven optimization decisions.

Job Family

IT Audit

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Conduct and document complex information technology (IT) audit projects. Ensures compliance with procedures and policies that protect the assets of the organization.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Assist management in planning and conducting complex IT audit and consulting projects, including the preparation of an objective risk-based assessment and audit approach.
  • Evaluate the adequacy of internal controls and develop creative and practical recommendations.
  • Serve as a technical advisor on IT aspects of financial and operational audits.
  • Audit IT operations within departments to verify computing controls are designed and operating effectively; prepare and submit clear, concise and insightful reports.
  • Determine proper technical and security configuration of technical systems and operations in infrastructure and IT.
  • Assist outside auditors with tasks to expedite completion.
  • Keep abreast of current technologies and IT best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, computer science or business degree with computing experience, or equivalent work experience.
  • Three years of IT audit experience.
  • Knowledge and experience in IT, including distributed computing, IT security, system development, computer operations, business continuity management and disaster recovery, application software, telecommunications and IT risk assessment.
  • Proven communication skills, orally and in writing, to work with all levels in the company.
  • Interpersonal and relationship-building skills to perform in an advisory capacity and lead/coach staff.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment.
  • Proficiency using MS Office tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or related certification.

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy:

Job Description:

Global Leave of Absence & Accommodations Leader

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As the Global Leave of Absence & Accommodations Leader, you will provide global leadership for the delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of Solventum’s Leave of Absence and Workplace Accommodations operations. Partnering closely with Total Rewards, which owns the overall program strategy and policy direction, you will be accountable for the global operating model, process strategy, operational excellence, service delivery, vendor governance, employee experience, and global team leadership across legally mandated leave and accommodation programs. Vacation, Paid Time Off, Holidays, Bereavement Leave, and Paid Sick Time are outside the scope of this role.

You will partner with stakeholders across Total Rewards, HR, Legal, Payroll, HRIS, Employee Relations, Occupational Health, Compliance, and business leadership while overseeing a strategic external leave administration partner responsible for day-to-day case management. This role is responsible for translating program strategy into scalable, compliant, and employee-centered service delivery across regions, ensuring clear accountability, consistent execution, and measurable outcomes for employees, managers, internal stakeholders, and external partners.

Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Leading Solventum’s global Leave of Absence and Workplace Accommodations process strategy, governance, end-to-end operating model, and long-term roadmap to deliver consistent, compliant, and scalable employee experience across regions.

  • Driving the evolution of the global Leave of Absence and Accommodations service model by establishing service delivery standards, streamlining and modernizing ways of working, and balancing enterprise consistency with country-specific statutory, regulatory, and works council requirements.

  • Partnering across Total Rewards, HR, Legal, Employee Relations, Payroll, Occupational Health, HRIS, Compliance, and business leaders to ensure seamless delivery of leave and accommodation programs and clear accountability across the global operating model.

  • Serving as the strategic relationship owner for the outsourced Leave Administration partner, driving vendor performance and accountability through governance oversight, SLA management, service improvement initiatives, compliance, escalations, audit readiness, and ongoing optimization of operational and employee experience outcomes.

  • Driving vendor governance through Quarterly Business Reviews, vendor scorecards, remediation planning, SLA performance reviews, and continuous service improvement to ensure measurable service outcomes and strong external partner accountability.

  • Championing an employee-centered leave and accommodations experience by applying service design and employee journey principles to simplify processes, improve communications, strengthen manager and employee education, enhance accessibility, support return-to-work, and embed service excellence standards across internal teams and external partners.

  • Owning and governing global process documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and employee and manager guidance materials to ensure consistent, compliant, and scalable Leave of Absence service delivery.

  • Ensuring compliance with applicable leave, disability, accommodations, privacy, and employment regulations across global markets, including the establishment of operational controls and audit evidence standards.

  • Driving operational excellence through process optimization, automation, AI-enabled solutions, digital employee experience enhancements, knowledge management, and vendor improvement initiatives.

  • Leading Workday User Acceptance Testing, business validation, and operational sign-off activities for leave and accommodation process enhancements, system changes, and workflow updates.

  • Using leave utilization, accommodation trends, operational metrics, vendor performance data, employee experience feedback, and compliance insights to inform executive decision-making, prioritize improvements, strengthen service performance, and drive measurable outcomes.

  • Leading and developing a high-performing global team with the capability, cross-training, and operational resilience needed to deliver consistent service execution, business continuity, vendor governance, process excellence, compliance, analytics, and complex case escalation support.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher AND ten (10) years of progressive experience in HR Operations, Total Rewards- Benefits, Leave Administration, Disability Management, Employee Relations, or a related discipline.

OR

  • High School Diploma AND fourteen (14) years of progressive experience in HR Operations, Total Rewards- Benefits, Leave Administration, Disability Management, Employee Relations, or a related discipline.

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • Five (5) years of experience leading enterprise-wide Leave of Absence and Accommodations programs.

  • Experience establishing governance, quality controls, and compliance frameworks for complex leave, disability, accommodations, or employee relations programs across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Experience managing outsourced service providers and vendor governance frameworks.

  • Strong knowledge of leave, disability, accommodation, and employment regulations across global markets.

  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing executive stakeholders.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, Organizational Development, or a related field.

  • Experience working with HR technology and case management platforms; Workday experience preferred.

  • Experience leading HR transformation, process redesign, or shared services global initiatives.

  • Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Project Management certification.

  • Experience implementing leave administration technologies or digital HR solutions.

  • Strong analytical, change management, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with operational excellence and a passion for employee experience. You will excel at:

  • Building scalable, compliant, and employee-centered leave and accommodation programs.

  • Translating leave, accommodations, vendor performance, and employee experience data into actionable insights that improve program design, compliance, service quality, and business outcomes.

  • Partnering closely with Total Rewards as the program strategy owner, and with HR, Legal, Payroll, Employee Relations, Occupational Health, HRIS, Compliance, and business teams to align priorities, resolve operational barriers, and ensure clear accountability for consistent leave and accommodations outcomes.

  • Holding vendors accountable for measurable service outcomes and continuous improvement through performance management and governance.

  • Leading change, simplifying processes, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life, both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Job Description:

Senior Manager, Registration & Database (Global Visa Program)

MKTG Sports + Entertainment is seeking a Senior Manager, Registration & Database to lead the build, management, and year‑round ownership of the global registration platform supporting Visa’s sports hospitality programs. This role is ideal for someone who has moved beyond general event planning and is now a true registration specialist — someone who understands platforms, data, workflows, and communication at a deep operational level. You will serve as the anchor for registration operations, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strong execution across global programs.

What You’ll Own

  • End‑to‑end ownership of the global registration platform, including builds, updates, data structure, and workflow accuracy

  • Creation and review of registration copy, guest communications, and program descriptions

  • Year‑round leadership of the registration team’s workload, priorities, and support for Visa programs

  • Management of customer database systems tied to registration, ensuring data quality and scalability

  • Daily registration operations including guest list management, attendee communications, and inquiry resolution

  • Registration reporting, dashboards, and client‑ready materials (guest lists, itineraries, collateral)

  • Cross‑functional alignment with event operations, guest experience, merchandise, and ticketing teams

  • Support for global merchandise operations including branding alignment, inventory tracking, and worldwide fulfillment

  • Clear communication of timelines, status, and next steps during client calls and internal meetings

  • Continuous improvement of registration processes, tools, and communication workflows

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in registration management, database management, ticketing operations, or program operations

  • Strong experience with registration platforms, websites, or customer data systems

  • Excellent writing skills for registration copy, guest communications, and system content

  • High comfort working with structured data, tracking progress, and maintaining accuracy

  • Experience supporting senior leaders, executives, or high‑profile clients

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and communication streams

Why This Role Matters

Visa’s global hospitality programs rely on a consistent, accurate, and scalable registration system. This role is the operational backbone — ensuring guests receive the right information, the right access, and the right experience every time. You will be the decision maker, the platform owner, and the person who keeps the entire registration ecosystem running smoothly.

The annual salary range for this position is $62,500–$80,000 annually. We base placement within the salary range on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation.

The Perks

Not only will you be joining a multi-award-winning Agency with great culture, you will also have the unique opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from our other offices across the globe. There is a whole heap of benefits that come with the role- a flexible holiday package starting at 20 days, corporate discounts, commuter benefits, cell phone reimbursement and much more. Our benefit plans have your total well-being in mind, and we offer an extensive list you can choose from to suit your needs.

About MKTG Sports + Entertainment

MKTG S+E is a global agency that harnesses the power of sports and entertainment for brands. For over 20 years, we've ignited fandom and innovated activation in the world of sports and entertainment to make something worth noticing, engaging, liking, sharing and remembering. We leverage deep INSIGHTS and our network of seasoned & creative team members to create IMPACT between properties, fans & brands.

Today, we help brands move at THE SPEED OF FANS which means we aim to know fans better than they know themselves. MKTG S+E is a part of the broader dentsu Sports International network.

Working with Us

We’re an agency born of fanatics…fans of sports (yes, even pickleball).

Fans of music (we sing in the shower).

Fans of data (we’re proud nerds).

Fans of art (from exhibitions to film).

Fans of culture (this is huge). And that means we put it all in for what we love, truly understanding what fans need, want, feel, hate and love about the brands and properties we lead.

We’re led by our core values which focus on collaboration, community, inspiring change, pursuing excellence, and celebrating bravery – all of which are foundational to our culture and how we treat each other and our clients.

We’re a community where you are free to be you, where good work gets rewarded, and you are truly energized by the team around you. It’s more than just ‘warm & fuzzies’ – happy humans are vital to our commercial success. And together, we make magic.

Inclusion and Diversity

We’re proud to be different and that starts with our people. To us, representation means more than just diversity, it means true equity. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. FromUbuntu One SSO toJuju,LXDandMAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.

This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.

As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.

You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.

In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.

jobs.excerpt: IN A NUTSHELL…Bellroy is a global brand (founded in Melbourne, Australia) with a bold growth plan.
jobs.description:
IN A NUTSHELL…

Bellroy is a global brand (founded in Melbourne, Australia) with a bold growth plan. Since we sold our first leather wallet in 2011, we’ve diversified into bags, tech accessories and travel gear. We're now a team of around 180+ staff, selling in more than 1,000 doorways and shipping directly to customers in 150 countries. Our US wholesale account base keeps expanding, with names like Nordstrom, Bloomingdales, REI, and Huckberry on the books, and we're after a Sales Coordinator to keep the engine room humming as that business grows.

This is the role that keeps orders moving and retailers in the loop. You'll process orders, manage inventory reservations alongside our planning team, and keep retailers and the wholesale team supplied with the data they need to make good calls. You'll be the person who spots the pricing error or the stock mismatch before it turns into a problem, and the one new retailers rely on to get their paperwork sorted. Coordination is the heart of this job, but you're part of the sales team, so some selling comes with it, and as you grow into the role there's room to take on more. Either way, you'll be the steady hand the whole wholesale operation leans on, and the work you do will be seen and credited by the team you do it with.

We worked out early that business could be a force for good. As a Certified B Corporation™ we keep looking for better ways to source our leathers, shrink our environmental footprint and make products that last. We're proud of what we make and just as proud of how we work with retailers, built on respect and a shared belief in good design. Because we're still founder-led and close-knit, decisions don't disappear into committees. You can raise something on Monday and see it change by Friday.

YOU COULD BE THE ONE IF YOU HAVE…

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in wholesale support, sales coordination, order management or a similar operations role, ideally in consumer goods, fashion or retail.
  • Worked in B2B platforms like NetSuite and NuOrder
  • Strong analytical chops and genuine attention to detail. Keeping price sheets and inventory updates accurate, with nothing slipping through, is your idea of a good day.
  • Clear, friendly communication, written and verbal. You can explain an invoice query to a retailer and a stock issue to the planning team, and have both walk away clear.
  • Solid organisation and prioritisation skills, with that knack for catching inconsistencies early, before they snowball into something bigger.
  • A collaborative streak and real comfort working across time zones with a globally distributed team (our planning and finance crew sit in Australia).
  • A solutions-focused attitude and the kind of energy that makes the people around you glad you're on the job.

Even if you don't tick every box, if you love bringing order to a busy wholesale operation and catching the small stuff before it grows, we'd love to hear from you.

IF YOU WERE HERE LAST WEEK, YOU MIGHT HAVE…

  • Processed a run of orders and reorders, then reserved inventory with the planning team so nothing got promised twice.
  • Answered a retailer wondering where their order or invoice was at, and cleared up a few SKU codes and product availability questions while you were there.
  • Pulled together a data update for a key retailer and the wholesale team so everyone was working from the same numbers.
  • Walked a new retailer through their onboarding paperwork and chased the last missing form so their first order could ship.
  • Caught a pricing inconsistency on a price sheet and fixed it before it reached a single customer.
  • Shared progress on orders processed at the weekly wholesale meeting, and flagged a looming inventory availability issue before it bit anyone.

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Competitive PTO offerings. This includes 20 days of PTO, 10 additional paid days of sick/personal time, plus national holidays (in line with our Australian policies, but with US public holidays) and paid parental leave
  • Extensive medical benefits package
  • A yearly product allowance as well as a further 50% discount for friends and family
  • An annual trip to Australia for the Bellroy conference, where you’ll benefit from learning and development sessions and meeting your colleagues in person
  • Fully remote work and a contribution to your work-from-home setup

LOCATION & HOURS

This is a full-time position based remotely in the U.S. You’ll report to a US based manager and need to communicate with our Melbourne office, so sufficient cross-over with Melbourne business hours is preferred. The salary range for this role is $55,000 - $65,000.

HOW TO APPLY

Before you apply, spend a bit of time at bellroy.com and have a read of what we stand for. If the way we work resonates with you, even better. If you're excited about this role and believe you could contribute, click apply!

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

As an MVNO Networks Manager at Airalo you will be responsible for establishing and managing the host operator partnerships that allow Airalo to operate its own networks locally. You will own each new market from the first conversation with a host mobile network operator through commercial negotiation, regulatory approval and technical integration to commercial launch, and you will remain its commercial owner once it is live.

You are someone who owns a market from its business case through to its commercial performance in operation. You are equally at ease negotiating terms with an operator's executive team, scoping the integration with their technical team, and running a service management review once the market is operational.

You will work in close coordination with our legal, finance, product, engineering and core network teams, as the local networks you establish need to interoperate with Airalo's existing platform and services.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Represent Airalo as the ideal interface to host mobile network operators on a global level

  • Identify, approach and secure new host network partnerships across target markets

  • Assess and recommend full MVNO or light MVNO constructs per market, including the commercial, technical and timeline implications of each

  • Build the business case for each new market together with Finance, and present it to Airalo's leadership team and to host operator executives

  • Negotiate terms and conditions of MVNO, wholesale and reseller contracts with host mobile network operators

  • Support Legal on the regulatory approvals required per market, including entity and licensing, numbering allocation and number portability, and provide information to product management

  • Work with the Delivery team on the implementation of regulatory obligations such as mobile number portability, lawful interception and emergency calling

  • Coordinate the technical integration of host mobile networks with Airalo's OSS and BSS platform together with our product, engineering and core network teams

  • Prepare and run the rollout of new markets, from launch readiness through to first commercial traffic

  • Hand over each launched market to our NOC and operations teams, and run regular service management reviews with host operators covering network quality, SLA compliance and incident performance

  • Perform escalations in case of network quality issues and availabilities

  • Define and perform reconciliation processes between host operator invoices and Airalo's own usage records

  • Define and run traffic, revenue and cost analytics per market, and report performance against business case

  • Renegotiate commercial terms with host operators as volumes grow and market conditions change

  • Develop and maintain a repeatable market entry playbook, and methods to assure unification of conditions and agreements

Must-haves:

  • 5 years minimum relevant experience in the mobile telco industry, in a commercial, wholesale or business development role

  • Having personally negotiated and closed at least two wholesale or MVNO agreements with host mobile network operators

  • Proven ability to build a market business case, including subscriber lifecycle assumptions, traffic forecasting, wholesale cost modelling, margin and payback, in close cooperation with Finance

  • Proven ability to present and defend a business case and its assumptions to a leadership team and to host operator executives

  • Experience owning commercial performance against forecast after launch, including contract renegotiation as volumes grow

  • Ideally having served within an MVNO, MVNA or MVNE, or on the operator side selling wholesale to them, with hands on mentality

  • Working knowledge of full MVNO and light MVNO architectures, including core, HSS/HLR, IMSI ranges, numbering and interconnect, and of the commercial trade-offs between them

  • Good overview in Telecommunication Network technologies like Mobile Core (PGW, IMS, Voice GW, HSS), OSS & BSS, and eSIM provisioning

  • Understanding different Mobile Network Generations like 2G, 3G/UMTS, 4G/LTE, 5G NSA and 5G SA and how they influence customer experiences

  • Ability to lead technical scoping and service management discussions directly with host operators, covering integration scope, launch dependencies, SLA definition and ongoing service reviews

  • Understanding the regulatory requirements on providing mobile services, including numbering, portability, emergency calling and lawful interception, and familiar with KYC processes for mobile subscriptions

  • Experience in a fast moving environment such as a startup, scale-up or challenger MVNO, with the ability to run several markets at different stages in parallel

  • Excellent English skills; in writing, speaking and reading, business fluent

  • Willingness to travel internationally occasionally to meet host operators

Good-to-have:

  • Having taken an MVNO from signed agreement through to live commercial traffic and first subscribers

  • Established working relationships with host mobile network operators and national telecom regulators

  • Experience selecting, contracting or managing an MVNE platform vendor

  • Prior ownership of a P&L or a country level budget

  • Master Studies and/or MBA highly preferred

  • Additional languages alongside English

Why People Join Us

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

You will work as part of a team and will be individually responsible for the delivery of value associated with your projects. You will be expected to follow processes and practices that allow your models to be incorporated into our machine learning platform for production execution and monitoring, however, initial exploratory data analysis allows for more flexible experimentation to discover solutions to the business problems presented.

  • Proficiency in all required skills and competencies above.
  • Communicating with others and teamwork.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THIS POSITIONAceable is looking for a Sr Analytics Engineer who likes solving holistic data problems.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THIS POSITION

Aceable is looking for a Sr Analytics Engineer who likes solving holistic data problems. This is a hands-on role that sits on a small team at the intersection of Data Engineering and Business Intelligence. In this role, you’ll be empowered to solve high-visibility data architecture and pipeline problems from beginning to end. One week you might build a new data pipeline or troubleshoot why data isn't landing where it should. The next week, you could be designing a dbt model, creating a semantic view or AI agent in Snowflake, building a Power BI dashboard, or partnering with a stakeholder to turn a fuzzy business question into a data product people can actually trust and use.

We don't expect you to be an expert in every tool we use. We do expect meaningful technical depth in multiple areas, strong problem-solving instincts, experience and excitement around AI, and the curiosity to jump into unfamiliar territory when the problem calls for it.

If you like variety, autonomy, solving messy problems, and building things from source data all the way through to the person making the decision, you will love working with us.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own data products end to end. Take a problem from source data all the way through to the dashboard, metric, or workflow someone actually makes a decision with. Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain the whole path rather than handing it off at each layer.
  • Turn fuzzy questions into things people trust. Work directly with partners in Marketing, Product, Finance, and Engineering to figure out what they're really asking, then build something reliable and maintainable enough that they stop asking you and just use it.
  • Own quality from source to screen. Build the testing, documentation, monitoring, and data quality controls that keep trust high, and when something breaks, chase it wherever it actually lives: pipeline, transformation, model, metric, or report.
  • Leave the platform better than you found it. Improve architecture, simplify workflows, and automate repetitive work, including using AI well to move faster on coding, investigation, testing, and documentation, while holding the line on accuracy and human review.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 7+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence Engineering, or a similarly technical data role
  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience building production-scale transformations in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake, dbt, and GitHub or close equivalents
  • A strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data marts, data quality testing, documentation, version control, code review, and software development lifecycle practices
  • Experience with at least one data integration, ETL/ELT, orchestration, or event-data platform, plus a solid understanding of how data moves from source systems through transformation and into downstream reporting
  • Experience building semantic models, DAX measurements, dashboards, and self-service data products using Power BI or an equivalent modern BI platform
  • The ability and judgment to take a highly ambiguous business problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into something reliable and maintainable, plus the communication skills to do that with deeply technical partners and stakeholders who just need the data to make sense
  • Experience building semantic layers, AI agents, or automated workflows that support generative AI and natural-language analytics and a willingness to use AI responsibly to accelerate technical work, automate repeatable processes, and continuously expand your capabilities

BONUS POINTS

  • Hands-on experience with Matillion or Segment
  • Experience supporting digital event instrumentation and transforming customer journey, product usage, and marketing data into trusted, analytics-ready datasets, especially in support of Marketing, Product, Finance, or executive decision-making
  • Familiarity with APIs, JSON, Python, Git, CI/CD, and automated deployment workflows
  • Experience with data observability, lineage, governance, privacy, role-based access, and warehouse cost optimization

ABOUT ACEABLE

Aceable has helped 20 million people get licensed in driver's ed, real estate, insurance, and mortgage. Behind every license is a first car, a new career, a fresh start. Making those moments possible is why we built Aceable.

We're profitable, growing, and investing heavily in AI to make licensing education better. Our courses are mobile-first, fully accredited, and built around one obsessive question: what's the most effective and engaging way to get someone to actually learn this? We’re proud that our students consistently outperform competitors on pass rates.

We move fast, ship to real students in weeks, and give our people genuine end-to-end ownership. If you want to build something that directly helps people start new careers (and have fun doing it) you're going to fit right in.

ABOUT THE BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE & DATA ENGINEERING TEAM

The Business Intelligence & Data Engineering team builds and supports the data products that help Aceable understand performance, make informed decisions, and operate more effectively. Our work spans data ingestion and event instrumentation, cloud data infrastructure, transformation and modeling, business intelligence, self-service analytics, and AI-enabled data experiences.

We are a small, highly collaborative team that values end-to-end ownership over rigid functional handoffs. Team members bring different areas of technical depth, but work together across the data lifecycle to deliver trusted, scalable solutions. We partner closely with teams throughout Aceable, including Marketing, Product, Finance, Operations, and Engineering, and are continually looking for ways to use AI and automation to increase our impact.

ACEABLE PERKS

  • Join one of Austin's Best Places to Work in 2024 & 2025
  • Competitive total rewards (base salary + bonus/stock options, if applicable)
  • 401k match
  • Robust medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Generous paid time off programs + 19 paid holidays per year
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Wellness programs
  • Our own space on the top floor of a downtown Austin building with free parking
  • Weekly lunch, a fully stocked fridge, and plentiful snacks
  • Company events and activities (holiday events, happy hours, volunteering)
  • #PursueGrowth Reimbursement ($600 per year for full-time employees)
  • Free Roadside Assistance subscription
  • Passionate teammates excited to help you succeed and learn
  • NOTE: Our team is currently working in a hybrid work environment with flexibility to work in office or remote based on role/department and location*

At Aceable we celebrate and support all differences. Aceable is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital, disability, and veteran status. Even if you don't think you meet every qualification listed, we'd love to review your application!

  • Strong experience with Java 17+ development

  • Experience developing REST APIs and web services
  • Strong experience with microservices, JPA/Hibernate, Maven, and Swagger/OpenAPI

  • Experience using Git-based source control
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

POSITION SUMMARY: The Software Development Engineer in Test provides testing services that mitigate the risk of software defects and increase the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of Republic Services’ software solutions. In addition, this role leads the end-to-end quality of projects within the Company’s Web, Mobile, and other Application Portfolios through test automation. The Software Development Engineer in Test is responsible for architecting new automated test strategies and frameworks in addition to creating, testing, and planning for both manual and automated test frameworks to optimize the testing of complex web and mobile applications. This role must demonstrate innovation, leadership, and mentorship skills in addition to possessing a strong technical and programming/test automation skill set. The Software Development Engineer in Test delivers creative and innovative solutions to support the development team through planning and prioritization of test design, test development, and test automation activities to be accomplished within an Agile methodology or other methodologies in support of a Continuous Delivery Pipeline with frequent application releases.

PRINCIPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coaches and mentors Software Test Engineers in the execution of automated testing efforts.

  • Leads effort to review product specifications and work with others to develop appropriate test strategies, detailed test plans, and test architectures.

  • Leads formal reviews of test plans, designs, and requirements with cross-functional teams.

  • Participates in the evaluation of new tools and technologies to continue enhancing the automation framework.

  • Researches, develops and/or recommends tools to assist Software Test Engineers in test planning, execution, and reporting.

  • Develops, debugs, and maintains test automation for applications and services.

  • Develops, implements, and automates test plans and test cases in an Agile environment.

  • Builds, executes, and maintains automated test frameworks for end to end integration testing across applications, devices, and platforms using JavaScript or other appropriate languages such as C#, Java, and TypeScript.

  • Builds automation and test coverage tools using JavaScript or other appropriate languages to enable Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery.

  • Builds or uses existing automation tools to test interfaces between systems and applications such as web services, Tibco services, or other APIs.

  • Accountable for all aspects of quality within the software development team.

  • Tracks and prioritizes defects throughout product releases and lifecycles.

  • Uses quality control tools and metrics to discover defects and make recommendations for resolution.

  • Report defects found through test automation.

  • Works with Agile teams or other IT teams to plan, estimate, schedule and execute testing for applications including:

    • Establishes, organizes and executes testing deliverables.

    • Documents and executes complex software test plans and strategies.

    • Ensures traceability of test cases back to project requirements.

    • Executes end to end test scenarios.

    • Coordinates and supports user-acceptance test plans.

    • Works with an Agile team or other IT teams to report and resolve complex issues.

  • Ensures software applications meet functional requirements.

  • Participates in all aspects of testing at all levels, including functional, system, regression and load testing.

  • Works collaboratively with Software Test Engineers and Developers.

  • Tests manually, as needed.

  • Records and reports on testing metrics.

  • Follows test documentation standards and makes updates as necessary.

  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned or apparent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with software automation testing methodologies including regression, functional, unit, integration, coverage, performance and load.

  • Experience testing applications that integrate with other systems through RESTful API's.

  • Experience with test management tools such as qTest, ALM, TFS, or similar tools.

  • Experience with API testing frameworks such as Karate, Gatling, JMeter, or Postman.

  • Some experience with load and performance testing.

  • Knowledge of Cloud platforms and services such as Amazon AWS, Azure, Heroku, Perfecto Mobile, and SauceLabs.

  • Experience in reviewing and providing feedback to team members during pull requests.

  • Understanding of Service Oriented Architecture.

  • Strong critical thinking skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal skills.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of 3 years of software test experience with test automation with a focus on web, mobile, database, or web services.

  • Experience in Agile software development methodology and using tools such as Rally, Jira, TFS, or ServiceNow.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript, C#, TypeScript, or other applicable languages as needed.

  • Advanced understanding of open-source web frameworks such as Angular, Bootstrap, Node.js, and Express.

  • Advanced understanding of web application testing tools such as Selenium, Jasmine, Protractor, Cucumber, Appium, or Cypress.

  • Understanding of source control tools such as Git or Subversion required.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. Recycling and Waste

The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.

We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.

Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives.

We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:

  • Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement
  • Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem
  • AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge
  • IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics
  • Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD
  • Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs
  • Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics
  • Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434
  • Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms

If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.

Location: These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region.

The role entails

  • Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales
  • Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track
  • Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities
  • Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations
  • Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training
  • Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings
  • Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams
  • Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic results at high school and university
  • Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community
  • Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices
  • Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape
  • A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement
  • Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning
  • A strong sense of ownership
  • Problem solving and the ability to innovate
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written
  • For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that we value

  • Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive)
  • Familiarity with the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channel
  • Familiarity with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker containers & Snaps
  • Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems
  • Familiarity with networking technologies - ethernet, IPv4 and IPv6, routing, firewalling, overlays such as OVN/OVS, VPNs, SR-IOV, infiniband
  • Familiarity with telco networking - RAN, Core, CPE
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones
  • Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and innovation in team settings

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.excerpt: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience.
jobs.description:
GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME: Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with type 1 diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

Clinical Diabetes Sales Specialist is verantwoordelijk voor het promoten en verkopen van Tandem Diabetes‑producten en klinische diensten binnen een toegewezen regio.


In deze rol werk je doelgericht aan het behalen van commerciële doelstellingen door **klinische acceptatie van Tandem’s insulinepomptherapie** te realiseren. Je identificeert potentiële klanten, bouwt sterke relaties op en ondersteunt zorgprofessionals bij het inzetten van Tandem‑oplossingen in de dagelijkse praktijk.

Deze functie gaat verder dan sales alleen: je bent een **vertrouwde klinische partner** voor zorgverleners, patiënten en mantelzorgers, met een duidelijke focus op **type 1 diabetes**. Met jouw klinische expertise bied je inhoudelijke ondersteuning, training en educatie aan patiënten, artsen en hun teams.

Je adviseert over de technische aspecten van insulinepomptherapie en speelt in op specifieke klinische en praktische vraagstukken om het gebruik van Tandem‑producten te stimuleren. Daarnaast verzorg je educatie over diabeteszelfmanagement, noodsituaties en beschikbare ondersteunende middelen, afgestemd op de behoeften van de klant.

Je werkt nauw samen met **endocrinologen, diabeteseducators en Key Opinion Leaders (KOL’s)** om productadoptie te vergroten, patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren en langdurige betrokkenheid bij Tandem te creëren.

Ben jij energiek, relatiegericht en gemotiveerd om écht impact te maken in het leven van mensen met diabetes? Dan is dit een rol die bij je past.



The Clinical Diabetes Sales Specialist is responsible for promoting and selling Tandem Diabetes products and clinical services within the assigned territory.

This role involves planning and achieving sales goals by gaining clinical acceptance of Tandem's insulin pump therapy products. The specialist will identify potential customers and develop business relationships to facilitate the use of Tandem Diabetes products and services.

This position goes beyond merely hitting sales targets; it focuses on becoming a trusted clinical partner to healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers—especially those managing the complexities of Type 1 diabetes.

The Clinical Diabetes Sales Specialist will use their clinical expertise to provide account sales support and ongoing education directly to patients, physicians, and their staff. This includes discussing the technical aspects of insulin pump therapy and addressing any special considerations related to its use in the marketplace to drive sales.

Additionally, the specialist will promote Tandem Diabetes products and services by offering education on various topics, such as diabetes self-management skills, emergency management, and community resources tailored to client needs.

You will collaborate closely with endocrinologists, diabetes educators, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to enhance product adoption, improve patient outcomes, and build long-term advocacy for Tandem solutions.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building authentic relationships, and are passionate about making a positive impact in the lives of people with diabetes, this is the role for you.

  • Als Clinical Sales Specialist bij Tandem Diabetes Care ben jij hét klinische en commerciële aanspreekpunt binnen jouw regio. Je combineert diepgaande diabeteskennis met saleservaring en bouwt duurzame relaties op met zorgprofessionals.

    Je ondersteunt zorgverleners en patiënten bij het gebruik van Tandem‑technologie, draagt actief bij aan groei in jouw regio en positioneert Tandem als een betrouwbare en innovatieve partner binnen de diabeteszorg.

    Wat ga je doen

    • Beheren van jouw regio en realiseren (of overtreffen) van commerciële doelstellingen

    • Opbouwen en onderhouden van sterke relaties met zorgprofessionals (o.a. endocrinologen, diabetesverpleegkundigen en diabeteseducators)

    • Adviseren en trainen van zorgverleners en patiënten in insulinepomptherapie en diabetesmanagement

    • Signaleren van nieuwe kansen en versterken van bestaande samenwerkingen

    • Organiseren en geven van product‑ en educatietrainingen

    • Samenwerken met interne teams (Sales, Medical Affairs en Customer Support) voor een optimale klant‑ en patiëntbeleving

    • Registreren van activiteiten in het CRM‑systeem en werken conform wet‑ en regelgeving

    Dit breng jij mee

    • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om vertrouwen op te bouwen

    • Goede kennis van diabeteszorg, bij voorkeur type 1 diabetes en insulinepomptherapie

    • Commerciële mindset gecombineerd met klinisch inzicht

    • Zelfstandige en gestructureerde manier van werken

    • Ervaring met CRM‑systemen en digitale tools (zoals Microsoft Office en Teams)

    • Bereidheid om veel te reizen binnen Nederland (±80%)

    • Vloeiende beheersing van Nederlands en Engels

    Extra pluspunten

    • Ervaring in medical devices, farmaceutische sales of diabeteszorg

    • (Para)medische achtergrond zoals verpleegkunde of diëtetiek

    • Directe ervaring met of affiniteit met mensen die leven met diabetes

    • Ervaring met Key Opinion Leaders (KOL’s)

    ✅ Waarom Tandem?

    Je werkt bij een innovatieve organisatie die écht impact maakt op het leven van mensen met diabetes, met veel zelfstandigheid, vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

    What Your Day Will Look Like

    You must be Fluent in Dutch

    • Cover your assigned territory to meet or exceed sales goals established by Sales Management.

    • Develop and execute strategies to address clinical concerns and retain existing relationships for Tandem Diabetes products and services.

    • Serve as a clinical and educational leader in your territory, with a strong focus on Type 1 diabetes management and insulin pump therapy.

    • Identify new business opportunities, build strong HCP relationships, and position Tandem as a trusted resource in the diabetes community.

    • Communicating clearly and earning trust with both HCPs and patients.

    • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively as a clinical expert to both patients and HCPs.

    WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

    SPONSORSHIP:

    Candidates must already be based and eligible to work in the Netherlands
