The Project Manager works closely with internal engineering teams, clients, and external stakeholders to ensure studies are executed accurately, on schedule, and within budget, while maintaining alignment with DLB standards and industry best practices.

The Project Manager will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments.  Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope.  Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Project Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (50%)

  • Lead execution of power systems studies projects from kickoff through final deliverables (reports, TCCs, arc flash labels, settings files)

  • Short circuit analysis

Manage Stakeholder Relations (20%)

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

jobs.title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO.
jobs.description:
We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.

Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001

Optional things we value

  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting-edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so they don’t have to.

The Help Desk II Technician serves as an escalation point for complex support tickets, providing advanced troubleshooting and technical leadership within the help desk team. This role involves managing tickets end-to-end, implementing technical solutions, and mentoring junior technicians. You will work across diverse client environments to ensure operational stability and high service quality.

  • Serve as a Tier 2 escalation for Help Desk I technicians, resolving advanced hardware, software, and network issues.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365, Intune, and Active Directory environments, including GPOs and security configurations.

  • Strong technical proficiency across Windows environments, networking fundamentals, and Microsoft cloud services.
  • Experience with ticket triage, prioritization, and root cause analysis in an MSP setting.
  • Familiarity with common COTS tools (SentinelOne, ThreatLocker, DUO, N-able, etc.).
  • Strong communication, customer service, and mentoring abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple client environments and competing priorities effectively.
  • Security-first mindset with focus on compliance and best practices.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related discipline preferred.
  • 3+ years of IT support experience, ideally in a Managed Service Provider or professional services environment.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, and MFA and DNS.

Work Environment:

  • Fast-paced, collaborative MSP culture with opportunities to expand into project work or system administration.
  • Exposure to enterprise-grade tools and clients across multiple industries.

Imubit is redefining how industrial companies around the world adopt and scale enterprise AI, adding millions of dollars to plant bottom lines while operating safely within constraints related to energy efficiency and sustainability.

Our AI platform supports real-time optimization across complex, nonlinear industrial systems, enabling both autonomous and guided decision-making in live production environments. Fortune 500 companies rely on Imubit to continuously improve profitability and sustainability across their most valuable assets.

Backed by Insight Partners, Imubit brings together deep domain expertise from companies such as Exxon and Shell with leading AI talent from Google and other top innovators. With teams across the United States, Europe, Asia, and a growing international presence, Imubit is transforming operational optimization across industries ranging from refining and aromatics to polymers and LNG liquefaction.

In this position, you will:

Account Ownership & Customer Success

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of industrial customer accounts, spanning the full account lifecycle from new project delivery through long-term sustainment.

Project Delivery Leadership

Sustainment & Value Expansion

Technical Credibility & Communication

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate a cross-functional delivery team (Implementation Engineers, data scientists, infrastructure) without direct management authority — earning influence through expertise and trust.
  • Partner closely with Account Directors on account strategy; collaborate with Business Consulting on expansion opportunities.
  • Share institutional knowledge across the delivery organization and contribute to the continuous improvement of Imubit's delivery methodology.

  • 5–10 years of experience in manufacturing-adjacent industries — refining, petrochemical, cement, mining, or similar industrial domains.
  • Demonstrated track record in one or more of the following: program or project management in a manufacturing or industrial setting; plant or process engineering with a customer-facing or consulting component; technical account management or customer success with industrial software or technology.

  • Customer Success Orientation: A genuine drive to help customers succeed, paired with the ability to manage expectations, handle difficult conversations, and turn skeptics into advocates.
  • Influence Without Authority: Skilled at aligning diverse stakeholders — both internally and externally — toward a shared outcome, without relying on a command-and-control structure.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

We do this by creating a culture of enthusiasm, resilience, adaptability, and teamwork every day in the office. We work hard to be our community’s employer of choice as we all live our purpose: We exist to unleash freedom for pet parents by keeping their pets happy, healthy and safe.

Summary of Position:

The DTC Ecommerce Operations & Insights Specialist keeps technical and commercial work moving from intake through completion and turns complex DTC data into clear actions. This person is equal parts hands-on project driver, data analyst, and ecommerce operator. They build workback plans, coordinate owners and dependencies, complete detailed execution and cleanup, analyze GA4, Tableau, and Shopify data, and use approved AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to accelerate analysis, synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows.

This is not an additional management layer and does not attempt to recreate a dedicated data-science function. It is a high-impact individual-contributor role designed to provide the technical project discipline, analytical capability, and hands-on operational follow-through needed to remove bottlenecks and create more capacity for channel owners to focus on strategy.

Core Responsibilities

1. Technical Project Management & Hands-On Operations

  • Own assigned technical and digital projects from intake through close, creating clear scope, requirements, workback plans, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive working sessions, follow-ups, status reporting, and handoffs so blockers are surfaced early, owners stay accountable, and work reaches a complete resolution.
  • Take on the unglamorous but essential 'elbow grease' work, including data cleanup, tracker maintenance, requirements reconciliation, platform configuration, tagging, testing, QA, documentation, and issue triage.
  • Translate business, marketing, and technical needs into actionable tasks and coordinate delivery across ecommerce, CRM/lifecycle, SEO, Brand, Category, Creative, analytics, technology, and external partners.
  • Build repeatable workflows, project templates, checklists, standard operating procedures, and decision logs that reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.

2. Data Analysis, Tableau & AI-Enabled Insights

  • Build, maintain, and improve trusted Tableau dashboards and reporting views that connect GA4, Shopify, CRM, retention, and other DTC data sources.
  • Analyze digital and commercial performance, including traffic, conversion, average order value, promotions, product and category trends, retention, repeat purchase, lifetime value, onsite behavior, and customer segments.
  • Use approved AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to explore data exports, identify patterns or anomalies, assist with formulas and queries, summarize findings, create documentation, and streamline repeatable analytical work.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs and underlying data before use, protect confidential or customer information, document assumptions, and clearly separate verified findings from directional hypotheses.
  • Reconcile inconsistent sources, maintain metric definitions, investigate data-quality issues, and translate findings into concise recommendations and next actions for channel and business owners.

3. DTC Ecommerce & Shopify Operations

  • Work comfortably within Shopify or Shopify Plus and supporting ecommerce platforms to execute approved product, collection, merchandising, promotional, navigation, content, and site-experience updates.
  • Support DTC campaigns from intake through launch by gathering product and offer requirements, preparing briefs and assets, coordinating dependencies, and completing platform production work.
  • Own detailed pre-launch and post-launch QA across products, pricing, promotions, creative, copy, links, tracking, mobile responsiveness, analytics, and the end-to-end customer experience.
  • Understand how Shopify data and ecommerce events flow into GA4, Tableau, CRM, and other reporting systems; partner with technical teams to investigate breaks or discrepancies.
  • Apply a strong understanding of DTC economics and customer behavior when prioritizing work, evaluating results, and recommending improvements.

4. Measurement, Testing & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with stakeholders to define goals, KPIs, data requirements, measurement plans, and post-launch readouts before work goes live.
  • Improve tracking consistency through disciplined UTM and link taxonomy, tagging requirements, documentation, QA, and dashboard governance.
  • Support structured testing and maintain a prioritized improvement backlog; produce recurring readouts that explain what happened, why it matters, and what the team should do next.

Role Boundaries & Decision Rights

The specialist owns delivery and analysis within agreed guardrails while preserving the strategic authority of existing channel and functional owners.

  • CRM/lifecycle, ecommerce, SEO, and other channel owners retain strategy, prioritization, governance, and final channel decisions.
  • This role can independently manage assigned projects, execute approved work, produce analysis, recommend actions, and coordinate delivery within agreed guardrails.
  • Material changes to strategy, offers, customer experience, brand direction, or roadmap priorities require approval from the appropriate owner.
  • AI tools must be used within company-approved security, privacy, and data-handling standards; outputs must be validated rather than accepted at face value.
  • This is a hybrid ecommerce operator with technical project and analytics capabilities - not a people manager, a narrowly defined PMO coordinator, a data engineer, an AI engineer, or a replacement for enterprise data science.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 3+ years of experience spanning DTC ecommerce operations, technical or digital project management, business intelligence, digital analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated hands-on project-management experience, including requirements gathering, workback planning, task ownership, dependencies, risk and issue management, status communication, QA, and project closure.
  • Strong Google Analytics 4 skills, including acquisition analysis, events and conversions, funnels, segmentation, exploration reports, campaign measurement, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Tableau experience building, maintaining, or improving dashboards and data views, plus strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for analysis and data cleanup.
  • Working knowledge of Shopify or Shopify Plus, including the admin environment, product and collection structure, promotions, merchandising, content publishing, and ecommerce data flows.
  • Practical experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable generative-AI tools for data analysis, synthesis, documentation, troubleshooting, or workflow efficiency, with sound judgment around validation and data privacy.
  • Understanding of DTC metrics and economics, including traffic, conversion rate, average order value, revenue, retention, repeat purchase, lifetime value, and promotional performance.
  • Excellent organization, curiosity, follow-through, and written and verbal communication, with a collaborative, low-ego willingness to do both strategic thinking and detailed execution.

Preferred

  • Experience in a multi-brand, multi-region, or high-SKU ecommerce environment.
  • Experience with Klaviyo, Sanity, Algolia, Recharge, Triple Whale, or comparable CRM, CMS, search, subscription, and attribution platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, data connectors, APIs, automation tools, or basic data-model concepts used to support Tableau and ecommerce reporting.
  • Experience with Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, Monday.com, or comparable project-management tools and operating cadences.
  • Familiarity with cohort analysis, promotional incrementality, digital experimentation, link tagging, campaign taxonomy, and responsible AI-enabled workflow design.

Measures of Success

  • Technical and digital projects move from intake to completion with clear ownership, dependable status, fewer blockers, and less rework.
  • The recurring 'elbow grease' backlog - cleanup, tagging, QA, documentation, dashboard maintenance, and follow-up - is completed consistently rather than accumulating.
  • The team has trusted, regularly used Tableau dashboards and consistent definitions for core DTC performance metrics.
  • GA4, Shopify, and campaign analyses produce clear recommendations that influence prioritization, testing, and commercial decisions.
  • AI-enabled analysis and documentation improve speed and capacity without reducing accuracy, judgment, privacy, or quality control.
  • Shopify changes, campaigns, promotions, and site initiatives launch accurately and on time, with stronger measurement and post-launch follow-through.
  • Channel owners regain measurable capacity for strategy because technical coordination, detailed execution, and analysis are reliably supported.

BENEFITS:

Working for PetSafe Brands definitely has its benefits. We offer a collaborative and creative team-oriented work environment where we encourage you to take risks to learn and grow! We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and 401K match. In addition we offer a rich wellness program which includes an onsite health clinic, workout facility and of course, we encourage you to bring your dog to work, which is our whole reason for what we do!

PetSafe Brands is dedicated to offering equal employment opportunity for all teammates and fostering a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. At PetSafe Brand, our teammates are our greatest strength. We strive to build a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve by hiring great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, life experiences, knowledge, self-expression and talent. We recruit and reward teammates based on capability and performance and together we are building a culture that welcomes all dimensions of an individual’s identity including race, color, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, educational background, national origin or ancestry, religion, veteran status, or physical ability. We embrace these differences and the unique contributions each teammate brings not just because it is the right thing to do but because it makes our company stronger. While we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging, we recognize that we still have more work to do and a lot more to learn.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleHistory is full of questionable decisions.
jobs.description:
About the Role

History is full of questionable decisions. We’re looking for someone who can turn them into a great story for Mr. Spherical.

We make animated YouTube videos about history, geopolitics and world events, and we need a writer who can make those subjects funny, engaging and worth sticking around for.

Think 70% entertainment, 30% education: strong characters, sharp dialogue, and real research underneath the comedy. Videos typically run 8–10 minutes, with an opening that earns attention and an ending that makes the whole story click.

We want viewers to leave laughing, knowing something new and feeling a little more curious about the world.

What You’ll Do

  • Primarily write at least two long-form scripts a month, typically 8–10 minutes each, plus occasional Shorts, in Mr. Spherical’s voice.
  • Pitch stories about history, geopolitics and world events, bringing your own ideas and developing those shared by the Creative Director.
  • Research each story and check the facts, keeping the important context accurate while finding room for comedy.
  • Write character-driven scenes with sharp dialogue and visual humour.
  • Hook viewers early, keep the story moving and make the ending count. We care especially about setups that pay off and endings that bring the whole story together.
  • Work through notes and rewrites with the Creative Director, who provides direction, feedback and final approval.

About You

  • You’ve written long-form YouTube videos and can show us examples.
  • Comedy, character writing and storytelling are your strengths.
  • You understand YouTube pacing and retention, including what makes someone keep watching after the opening.
  • You can research unfamiliar historical, geopolitical, or current events topics, verify your facts, handle sensitive topics, and turn them into clear, engaging stories
  • You’re comfortable owning a script from pitch through revisions and meeting agreed deadlines.
  • Your work has reached hundreds of thousands or millions of views, and you can talk about what helped it connect.

Experience in history or geopolitics is valuable, but strong comedy and character-driven storytelling come first.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Make people laugh, help them understand the world, and leave them curious enough to keep exploring.
  • Bring your own ideas and humour, and work with a creative team to turn them into animated characters and scenes.
  • Help Mr. Spherical grow through stories that bring in new viewers and give people a reason to come back.
  • Write for an established audience, with the potential to reach millions

We are seeking an experienced SAP HANA Engineer to design, build, and optimize HANA-native data models and analytical objects supporting S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, and standalone HANA platforms. In this role you will translate complex business and analytics requirements into performant HANA models, and you will be the go-to expert for diagnosing and resolving HANA performance issues across the SAP landscape. jobs.excerpt: Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
jobs.description:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, こんにちは!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Tokyo, Japan. So we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

This role requires at least 20 hours of work per week. このポジションは、週に最低20時間の稼働を想定しています。

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

担当いただく業務

This role is focused on our template Library — the design content marketplace where millions of users start their design journey — rather than Brand or external-facing creative work. 本ポジションは、何百万人ものユーザーがデザインの第一歩を踏み出す場である、テンプレートライブラリ（デザインコンテンツのマーケットプレイス）に特化した役割であり、ブランドや対外向けクリエイティブ制作は対象外です。

  • Create a range of fresh, varied and beautiful designs for our Japan community. 日本のコミュニティ向けに、新鮮でバラエティ豊かな美しいデザインを幅広く制作します。

  • Develop unique concepts for templates across themes and topics that resonate in Japan. 日本のユーザーの共感を呼ぶテーマやトピックに沿って、テンプレートのユニークなコンセプトを開発します。

  • Collaborate with asset creators to develop supporting design elements — illustrations and design elements — that make templates shine. アセットクリエイターと連携し、テンプレートを引き立てるイラストや写真素材などのアセット開発をサポートします。

  • Suggest new design styles and creative directions that fit what local users want. ローカルユーザーのニーズに合った新しいデザインスタイルやクリエイティブの方向性を提案します。

  • Focus on quality management for Creator templates, partnering with the Creator Template Review Team to lift overall design quality and keep everything on-brand. クリエイターテンプレートの品質管理に注力し、クリエイターテンプレートレビューチームと連携して全体的なデザイン品質を高め、ブランドとの整合性を維持します。

  • Use AI tools to create templates at scale for the Japan market, without compromising craft or cultural relevance. AIツールを活用し、クオリティや文化的な関連性を損なうことなく、日本市場向けにテンプレートを大規模に制作します。

  • Write Creator briefs that give clear direction, context and inspiration, so Creators can do their best work. クリエイターが最高の成果を発揮できるよう、明確な方向性・背景情報・インスピレーションを伝えるクリエイターブリーフを作成します。

  • Partner with the Design Lead to manage freelancer designers — keeping work on track, on-brief and shipping on deadline. デザインリードと連携し、フリーランスデザイナーをマネジメントします。進行管理、ブリーフとの整合性、納期内の納品を徹底します。

What we're looking for

求める人物像・スキル

  • Experience as a Graphic, Brand or Visual Designer across digital and print marketing. デジタルおよび印刷媒体のマーケティング領域における、グラフィックデザイナー、ブランドデザイナー、またはビジュアルデザイナーとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。

  • A genuine love for design trends and styles specific to Japan. 日本ならではのデザイントレンドやスタイルに強い関心と情熱をお持ちの方。

  • A portfolio that shows your passion for clean, elegant, beautiful design. 洗練された、シンプルで美しいデザインへのこだわりが伝わるポートフォリオをお持ちの方。

  • Strong craft in hand illustration, typography, colour, conceptual graphic design and layout. 手描きイラスト、タイポグラフィ、カラー、コンセプチュアルなグラフィックデザイン、レイアウトにおいて、高いデザインスキルをお持ちの方。

  • A sharp eye for visual, cultural and pop culture trends. ビジュアル、カルチャー、ポップカルチャーのトレンドを敏感に捉える感性をお持ちの方。

  • A strong stylistic point of view, grounded in design fundamentals. デザインの基礎をしっかりと身につけたうえで、自分なりの明確なスタイルやクリエイティブの視点をお持ちの方。

  • You design with the end user in mind, and deliver great work on deadline and to brief. 常にエンドユーザーを意識してデザインし、ブリーフに沿った高品質な成果物を期限内に仕上げられる方。

  • You've given design feedback before — and you know how to make it clear, kind and useful. デザインに対するフィードバックの経験があり、明確かつ相手を尊重した、実践につながるフィードバックができる方。

  • Experience using Canva is a plus, helping you get up to speed quickly from day one. Canvaの使用経験があると、入社初日からスムーズに業務を進められるため歓迎します。

When applying to this role, please provide the following:

ご応募の際は、以下をご提出ください

  • Your resume 履歴書・職務経歴書

  • A link to your portfolio ポートフォリオへのリンク

About the Group/Team

Our marketplace of templates provides the perfect place for our users to begin their design journey. The Canva team wants to work with talented designers from across the world, to redefine what’s possible for a template - creating a new benchmark for fresh, high-quality design content within our collection. We're aiming to build the world’s best design marketplace, with a library of designs that offer our users a wide variety of usable and dynamic content - and to do that, we need the help of talented designers that can create amazing content.

About the Role/Specialty

Canva's on a mission to democratise design, and localisation is a big part of that. It's not enough to translate content from English — we want every market to have templates that reflect their own design aesthetics and trends. Working closely with copywriters, illustrators, market growth and localisation specialists, you'll oversee the end-to-end rollout of the Japan content library.

This role goes beyond designing templates yourself. You'll also shape what our external Creators make — writing clear Creator briefs, managing quality of their template submissions, and using AI to create templates at scale for the Japan market. You'll partner with the Design Lead to help manage our freelancer designers, keeping work aligned, on-brief and on-time.

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions.

Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.

Description of Role

Centessa is seeking a (contract-to-hire) Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) to lead the execution of global clinical studies from startup through closeout and clinical study report. This role is a temporary position with the potential to convert to a permanent role,accountable for study delivery, including operational strategy, timelines, budget, quality, vendor oversight, risk management, and inspection readiness. This individual in this role will lead cross-functional teams and manage CROs and external vendors to ensure studies are conducted efficiently, compliantly, and in alignment with program objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, execution, and oversight of global clinical trials from startup through closeout. 
  • Serve as the primary operational lead for assigned studies, driving cross-functional alignment and execution. 
  • Develop and manage study timelines, budgets, enrollment forecasts, risk mitigation plans, and key performance metrics.  
  • Oversee CROs and external vendors to ensure delivery against scope, quality standards, timelines, and budget.  
  • Drive critical study milestones, including site activation, enrollment, database lock, and study closeout.  
  • Review and approve study plans, vendor deliverables, and trial documentation to ensure compliance with protocol, GCP, and regulatory requirements.  
  • Identify operational risks and issues, implement mitigation strategies, and escalate as appropriate. 
  • Lead study team meetings and provide regular updates to stakeholders and senior management.  
  • Ensure Trial Master File (TMF) quality, completeness, and inspection readiness throughout the study lifecycle. 
  • Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and Health Authority interactions.  
  • Contribute to process improvements and mentor junior clinical operations team members as needed. 
  • Collaborate effectively with global teams, investigators, CROs, and vendors across multiple regions. 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, health-related, or equivalent discipline required.
  • 8+ years of clinical research experience, including 5+ years of clinical trial management experience within a sponsor or CRO environment.  2+ years of managing Phase 1 Healthy Volunteer studies.    
  • Experience in standard clinical pharmacology package studies such as: First in Human, Drug to Drug Interaction, Human Absorption, Metabolism, Excretion and Mass Balance, Relative Bioavailability, Bioequivalence, Organ Impairment, Abuse Liability studies.  
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading Phase 1 studies, global Phase II and/or Phase III clinical trials.
  • Experience managing CROs, CRUs, central vendors, and cross-functional study teams.
  • Neuroscience/CNS clinical development experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting inspection readiness, audits, and regulatory interactions preferred. 

Compensation

The hourly range for this position is $70.00 to $100.00 per hour. Individual compensation within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and job knowledge. 

Contractors engaged through Centessa are employed through a third-party agency that serves as the employer of record and provides access to a comprehensive benefits package. Eligible contractors may enroll in medical plans, including PPO and EPO options, as well as dental and vision coverage after 30 days. Additional perks, such as a 401(k), wellness programs, and other discounts, may also be available to eligible contractors. 

Work Location

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager role is a based in the US (Remote), with occasional travel required.

POSITION: Temporary, non-exempt

Job Title

Sales Enablement Manager

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. ViaCord is seeking an experienced Sales Enablement Leader to build and lead a scalable enablement function that drives sales effectiveness, productivity, and performance. This role will develop and execute the sales enablement strategy, including onboarding, training, coaching, sales methodology, content, and performance programs that help sales teams and leaders achieve business objectives.

As the architect of ViaCord's Sales Excellence framework, this individual will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Customer Experience, Clinical Market Development, Project Management, Finance, and Quality to improve sales conversion, new-hire readiness, CRM adoption, sales productivity, and customer experience.

Sales Enablement Strategy

  • Develop and execute the sales enablement roadmap aligned to business goals.
  • Establish sales competency models, certification standards, and enablement success metrics.
  • Identify organizational skill gaps and recommend training, tools, and resources to address them.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to leadership on sales effectiveness and performance improvement opportunities.

Onboarding & Sales Development

  • Monitor onboarding effectiveness, time-to-productivity, and certification completion.
  • Ensure ongoing development programs support continuous learning and skill reinforcement.

Sales Coaching & Performance Excellence

  • Lead sales coaching initiatives, including individual coaching, call reviews, workshops, and manager enablement.
  • Partner with sales leaders to improve coaching effectiveness and drive performance improvement.
  • Develop coaching frameworks, tools, and best practices to support consistent sales execution.

Sales Process, Methodology & Enablement Content

  • Own and maintain ViaCord's sales methodology, key sales processes, and enablement playbooks.
  • Standardize customer engagement practices and sales execution standards.
  • Develop and maintain sales tools, messaging frameworks, talk tracks, objection-handling resources, and supporting documentation.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing, Customer Experience, and other stakeholders to align enablement initiatives with business priorities.
  • Support product launches, process improvements, and change-management initiatives.
  • Use performance data to evaluate enablement effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

  • Healthcare, fertility, diagnostics, life sciences, or healthcare-adjacent industry experience.
  • Sales enablement, instructional design, or learning and development certifications.
  • Experience building an enablement function, academy, or certification program.

  • Experience supporting commercial transformation, change management, or process improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive adoption of new processes and tools.

jobs.description:
SES Electrical LLC is expanding its workforce and is seeking a Project Manager to join our growing Constructin West Business Line. We are committed to fostering a work environment that offers long-term stability and growth. We value our employees and are dedicated to supporting their success throughout their career with us. With a strong track record of consistent growth, we provide a secure and dependable workplace for those looking for a lasting career.

This role entails scheduling, subcontractor management, communication with the client and building occupants, safety and occupational health management, and assurance of quality and compliance. Responsible for overseeing a variety of construction projects, including design-build and bid-build projects typically ranging from $2M to $15M, with the potential to manage up to $20M of projects simultaneously.

SES Electrical LLC offers a great benefits package complete with medical, dental, and vision insurance, health savings account health reimbursement account, flexible spending account, employer paid life and disability, 401(k) matching, and paid time off along with other essential benefits.

This position will report to our office location: Seattle WA or remote

Salary Range: $125,000-$145,000/annual

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties, but not all duties performed for this position. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Procurement of subcontractors, coordination, organization, and supervision of construction activities to ensure on-time delivery, adherence to budget constraints, and upholding high-quality standards and safety regulations.
  • Analyze project RFPs and plans, collaborating with executives to define project objectives effectively.
  • Efficiently oversee labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractors within the allocated time and budget.
  • Foster strong relationships with vendors, subcontractors, field staff, and clients throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage the evaluation and acquisition of subcontracts, labor, materials, and equipment.
  • Supervise the project closely to promptly address out-of-scope work requests, unforeseen conditions, and time impacts.
  • Work closely/manage superintendents, stakeholders, and team members to develop and revise project schedules.
  • Develop and scrutinize/manage project budgets and cost estimates meticulously.
  • Client and Subcontractor Invoicing management and processing.
  • Review and execution of subcontracts and purchase orders
  • Manage project from proposal stage through closeout
  • Handle any issues that arise resulting from unforeseen conditions
  • Effectively manage and build teamwork within the project execution team
  • Manage subcontractors through project completion
  • Coordinate with Quality Control and Safety representatives
  • Direct project activities to ensure conformance to project budget, plans, specs, and schedule
  • Forecast project cash flow in relation to the project schedule
  • Track the financial performance of projects
  • Prepare project reports for management and clients
  • Interface with client/customer satisfaction
  • Maintain our excellent reputation
  • Manage overall project team activities

Minimum Qualifications:

To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The qualifications listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • 10+ years of related construction experience or equivalent combination of experience and education
  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in engineering, construction, or a related field preferred
  • 5 – 10 years of Federal construction (USACE, NAVFAC, GSA, VA, USAF, etc.)
  • Management of Design Build and Bid Build projects
  • MATOC/Task Order experience
  • Ability to travel to project locations
  • Proficient time management, organization, prioritization, action item tracking, reporting, computer, etc. skills
  • Ability to help decipher and solve technical issues relating to construction
  • Strong customer service ability
  • Skilled in conflict resolution
  • Good understanding of legal processes
  • Able to maintain morale within the group and foster an environment of strong team spirit
  • Scheduling
  • Familiar with P6 Primavera
  • Experience/proficient with RMS and the Quality Control process
  • Experience with Procore
  • Experience with EM-385 safety requirements

Additional Qualifying Factors:

As a condition of employment, you will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screening (post accepted offer) and have acceptable background check results. If applicable to the contract, you must also obtain the appropriate clearance levels required and be able to obtain access to military installations.

Necessary Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The position requires the ability to remain seated at a desk for extended periods, up to 7–8 hours per day. The employee must be able to operate a computer keyboard and mouse and view a monitor for extended periods, including performing repetitive hand and wrist motions. Close vision sufficient for reading documents and computer screens, as well as the ability to adjust focus, is required. The employee must be able to communicate clearly in person, by phone, and during virtual meetings. The position also requires the ability to move throughout the office environment, including between workstations, meeting rooms, and common areas, and to occasionally lift and carry items weighing up to 15–25 pounds, such as files, equipment, and supplies.

The position may also require occasional travel to and navigation of active project sites. This includes the ability to walk on uneven, unpaved, or unfinished terrain; climb stairs, ladders, or temporary structures; and stand for extended periods during site walkthroughs. Employees must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including a hard hat, safety glasses, high-visibility vest, and steel-toe boots, and tolerate outdoor conditions such as heat, cold, dust, and noise for the duration of a site visit.

Working Conditions

Job is performed in a combination of office and outdoor site locations. The office setting includes exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, and mouse. Outdoor settings include walking, driving, and carrying supplies throughout all seasons with exposure to heat and cold conditions, and potentially wildlife. Is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals and loud noise.

Bristol Bay Construction Holdings LLC (BBCH) is a holding company of Bristol Bay Native Corporation, an Alaska Native Corporation. The BBCH family of companies include 8(a), small, and large businesses operating under the Aerostar, CCI, CSI, Herman, and SES brands. The vision of BBCH is to be best value companies and employers of choice, recognized for our dedication to our unity of purpose, values, employees, clients, and shareholders. For three decades, our best-value companies have provided federal and commercial clients with superior quality and cost-effective, innovative, and sustainable solutions for general construction, restoration services, civil works, fuels systems, environmental services, professional services, and facility support services.

BBCH gives lawful hiring, promotion, training, and retention preference to BBCH shareholders, shareholder descendants, and shareholder spouses who meet the minimum qualifications for the position. While preference is given to these individuals, all employment decisions are based on qualifications and business needs. We are an equal-opportunity employer. jobs.description:
AI Data Platform Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Data Platform Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $135,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Job Summary
We are seeking a AI Data Platform Engineer to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the target-state architecture of the enterprise data platform, including ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, schema evolution, partitioning, file formats, and storage organization.
  • Architect lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Design end-to-end data pipelines that balance latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Lead the integration of governance, lineage, and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Unity Catalog, or DataHub.
  • Define security architecture including row- and column-level controls, masking, encryption, and identity-aware access patterns.
  • Partner with ML, BI, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities align with downstream consumption needs.
  • Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.
  • Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.
  • Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.
  • Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.
  • Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.

jobs.description:
Materials Science Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Overview

The Vice President, Finance Data & Analytics will lead the evolution of the company's financial and business analytics capabilities, connecting financial, commercial, and operational data into an integrated view of enterprise performance to support decision-making across the organization. Positioned within Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), this leader will build and lead a high-performing Finance Data & Analytics team, partnering closely with Finance, business units, and Technology and Data teams to modernize business intelligence, advance a trusted data foundation, and accelerate the practical application of automation and advanced analytics while leveraging artificial intelligence to perform at scale.

The successful candidate will combine strong financial and business acumen with data, analytics, and technology expertise, and will be equally comfortable engaging with technical teams, business leaders, and senior executives.

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision and multi-year strategy for Finance Data & Analytics, spanning financial and business data, analytics, reporting, automation, and artificial intelligence, aligned with the company's strategic priorities, and measure progress against clear success metrics.
  • Serve as a strategic partner across FP&A, Finance, business units, enterprise functions, Technology and Data teams, and executive leadership, connecting financial, commercial, customer, and operational data into an integrated view of performance and translating it into clear insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Build upon a trusted, governed data foundation in partnership with Technology and Data, and modernize management reporting and business intelligence, including Power BI, dashboards, self-service analytics, and driver-based insights, so leaders can quickly understand performance and act.
  • Integrate commercial and operational information, including CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Salesforce, to improve visibility into pipeline, bookings, revenue, retention, and profitability.
  • Develop and execute a practical roadmap for applying AI, advanced analytics, and automation to forecasting, variance analysis, reporting, scenario modeling, and anomaly detection.
  • Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing Finance Data & Analytics organization, establishing an operating model and talent capabilities that promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with business and functional leaders to improve forecasting, performance management, and KPI reporting, and establish trusted, consistently defined enterprise metrics.
  • Lead adoption of new technologies and ways of working, building stakeholder alignment so new capabilities translate into sustained improvements in decision-making.
  • Lead top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that can employ best-in-class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction. Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier talent.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred.
  • 12-15+ years of progressive experience across Finance, FP&A, data and analytics, business intelligence, technology, or transformation, including significant leadership experience in a complex, multi-business-unit enterprise.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, including a demonstrated understanding of FP&A, forecasting, planning, financial statements, and performance management.
  • Demonstrated success leading data, analytics, technology, or digital transformation, including the ability to simplify processes and create scalable approaches that improve productivity.
  • Proven experience building, developing, and leading high-performing teams across analytical, financial, technical, and business disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of modern data and analytics environments, including data architecture, governance, integration, business intelligence, and self-service analytics, with significant experience in visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI.
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Salesforce, and with integrating commercial information with financial and operational data.
  • Experience with enterprise planning, forecasting, ERP, data warehouse/lakehouse, or automation platforms, and a strong understanding of AI and advanced analytics with practical business applications.
  • Ability to partner with data architects, engineers, and technology leaders and translate technical concepts into financial and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and recommendations for senior executives.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of complex financial, operational, commercial, and technical information to identify meaningful patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Strong analytical reasoning, systems thinking, and judgment, including the ability to structure and solve complex problems where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.
  • Ability to connect operational and commercial activity to financial outcomes and identify the business drivers most relevant to enterprise performance.
  • Ability to move effectively between strategic and detailed thinking, and to translate between financial, business, analytical, and technical concepts for business, Finance, technical, and executive audiences.
  • Ability to evaluate competing priorities and alternatives and exercise sound judgment based on business value, scalability, risk, and strategic importance.
  • Ability to lead through organizational and technological change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and build alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity, sound judgment with confidential information, and intellectual curiosity toward emerging technologies such as AI and automation.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

Base compensation ranges from $220,000 to $275,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

We design, develop, and manufacture advanced AI, video analytics, surveillance cameras, and access control solutions that are changing the way people interact with their security systems. Our solutions are installed around the globe spanning many industries and we are constantly pushing the envelope to deliver new leading-edge features to our customers.

The Avigilon Alta Video team is responsible for the cloud video security portfolio within the Video Security and Access Control business unit of Motorola Solutions.


Job Description

You will love this role if you enjoy solving complex problems! You will become the bridge between our customer-facing support team and the development team and you will quickly become critical to the business. Working alongside the hardware & software development engineers and closely with our global customer support team, the Alta Video Engineering Escalations team is the external-facing side of the R&D organization. We are justifiably proud to hire escalations engineers who are recognized as the best in the industry.

Support queries are initially handled by Motorola’s partner network, with more complex cases being passed to Motorola’s global support team. The most complex issues are passed onto the relevant Escalations team for the product. Your role involves investigating, solving and managing these often difficult and challenging issues. In order to be successful you will have to work closely with the support team, R&D, product test group, sales, the documentation team and partners in replicating and diagnosing issues. You will need to meet tight deadlines, sometimes under pressure, while effectively managing priorities and communicating progress.

One of the great attractions of the role is the detailed knowledge you will gain on the full functionality of our advanced cloud video security products as well as many leading 3rd party products.

Responsibilities:

  • Become an expert on all of our products, on related industry products and how they are used together.

  • Take ownership of escalated support issues and ensure each one is managed through to the point that it is resolved to the customer’s satisfaction and within established SLA’s.

  • Minimize development and test times by gathering accurate descriptions of environments and symptoms seen by customers and providing expert insights.

  • Reproduce customer issues in our lab and troubleshoot complex functional and integration issues by analyzing logs by using deep inspection tools (e.g. network packet traces).

  • Engage with the development and test teams to demonstrate how to reproduce problems

  • Test code changes and “work arounds” to verify fixes.

  • Provide accurate information on the status of support cases and communicate progress back to customers.

  • Demonstrate a genuine interest in learning about new technologies with a passion for solving complex problems and reverse engineering things.

  • Conduct full stack troubleshooting of the Alta Video Solution including, network, hardware and software

  • Have a strong attention to detail.

  • Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Able to collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to test new products and identify bugs.

  • Ability to write technical knowledge base articles and whitepapers.

It is considered a bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Linux, APIs, Python or other coding languages

  • Experience of video surveillance devices and protocols such as ONVIF

  • A good understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting including HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, VLANs, TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, DHCP, firewalls and software systems.

  • Experience working in a customer facing role but also interacting with R&D teams

  • Experience working with video surveillance solutions
