  • Coordonner plusieurs initiatives d'approvisionnement et négociations contractuelles simultanées tout en gérant la priorisation à travers divers comptes

  • Collaborer avec les services juridiques et de gestion des risques corporatifs pour assurer que les termes contractuels respectent les normes et faciliter l'approbation des modifications non standard

Qualifications requises :

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, approvisionnement ou domaine connexe, OU expérience équivalente avec 5+ années en gestion de l'approvisionnement et des contrats soutenant l'immobilier, les services d'installations ou l'approvisionnement corporatif

  • Expérience démontrée en intégration de fournisseurs, négociation et administration de contrats avec une solide compréhension des termes commerciaux, de la répartition des risques et des accords de niveau de service

  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français (canadien) – à l'écrit et à l'oral – requise pour une communication efficace avec les parties prenantes à travers les opérations américaines et canadiennes

  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et en communication avec capacité démontrée à influencer les parties prenantes et à bâtir des relations de collaboration

  • Flexibilité et adaptabilité pour travailler avec des exigences clients variées, des structures de comptes diverses et des cycles de projets multiples

Qualifications préférées :

  • Connaissance des processus RFx (DDI/ADP/DAP) incluant la stratégie d'approvisionnement, l'évaluation des fournisseurs et les procédures d'attribution de contrats

  • Maîtrise avancée de la suite MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); expérience avec des plateformes technologiques d'approvisionnement telles que les outils d'e-sourcing, les systèmes de gestion de contrats et les portails fournisseurs

  • Solides compétences en gestion de projet avec capacité à gérer plusieurs initiatives simultanées à travers différents comptes et zones géographiques

  • Connaissance des règlements d'approvisionnement du Québec et du droit des affaires canadien

As a Bilingual Sourcing & Contracts Specialist at JLL, you'll play a pivotal role in managing supplier relationships and contract lifecycles across our US and Canadian operations. This position is central to ensuring seamless supplier onboarding, compliance, and risk management for multiple client portfolios.   • Flexibility and adaptability to work across varying client requirements, account structures, and project lifecycles

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager, who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Business Systems team is responsible for systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and several others. The engineers work closely with operations teams, implement business processes, and keep the systems compliant. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineering leader with a genuine interest in understanding the business, high engineering standards, and drive to deliver first-class experience to Canonical employees using those systems to get their job done.

The Data Governance team has a mission to enable a secure and well-governed access to comprehensive data sets originating at many internal and external data sources formed in a data mesh. The team works with well-known open-source data governance tools such as Trino and Ranger, defines and executes data governance processes, and democratizes the data at Canonical.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Performance engineering and SRE experience
  • Experience with data governance, data engineering, or data science
  • Experience with accounting, sales, sales operations, or other business roles

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave

  • Employee Assistance Program

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you're a senior voice on Engine's central infrastructure team — the group that owns the substrate every product team at Engine ships on top of. Your work is horizontal by default: the patterns you design, the modules you ship, and the paved roads you maintain are used across every business vertical.

You'll be hands-on with:

  • Cloud infrastructure — the AWS accounts, networking, deployment patterns, and operational tooling that Engine's product teams depend on day to day.
  • Terraform — designing and evolving the shared module registry that feature teams across the company consume.
  • CI/CD — pipeline templates and GitHub Actions workflows that set the standard for how code ships at Engine.
  • Reliability & observability — Datadog dashboards, SLO frameworks, and incident response tooling used org-wide.
  • Security & networking — Cloudflare configuration, IAM boundaries, and secret management as platform-level primitives.
  • Cost visibility — building the tooling and reporting that helps every team understand and act on what they own and spend.

You'll partner closely with feature teams across verticals — not by embedding with them, but by running a tight feedback loop: understanding their friction, prioritizing what deserves a paved road, and shipping platform capabilities that make the right path the easy path.

What You'll Do

  • Set the technical direction for a major area of Engine's infrastructure over a multi-quarter horizon — where it's headed, what you're deliberately not building, and how platform investments compound rather than fragment.
  • Lead multiple infra initiatives in parallel, coordinating across the central team and with the feature teams who'll adopt what you build.
  • Design and ship the Terraform modules, pipeline patterns, and operational tooling that product teams adopt because they're better than the alternative — not because they're mandated.
  • Separate signal from noise across the feature-team requests that land on the central team. Decide what deserves a paved road, what belongs in team-owned space, and what shouldn't be built at all.
  • Own the boring-but-critical work: incident response, on-call quality, deployment reliability, vendor integration health.
  • Shape the guidelines, tools, and methods every engineer at Engine uses — and coach the feature engineers who apply them.
  • Represent the infra team in cross-functional conversations with product and engineering leadership. Our team meets twice a week — that's where you'll share what's shipping, align on priorities, and pressure-test decisions.
  • Reduce the SDLC step-function count across Engine. Every approval gate, every "ask infra first" workflow is a tax — your job is to lower it.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 6+ years building and operating production cloud infrastructure, with deep AWS expertise (multi-account, networking, IAM, security boundaries).
  • Expert-level Terraform — you've designed reusable modules and have opinions about state, drift, and execution patterns.
  • Strong CI/CD background — GitHub Actions, reusable workflows, OIDC, secret management.
  • A track record of shipping platform infrastructure that feature teams actually adopt — you know how to build for internal customers without losing sight of what makes something feel like a product.
  • A bias toward enabling teams over gatekeeping. You'd rather build the paved road than approve the off-road permits.
  • Experience leading technical direction across multiple teams — making the trade-offs precisely, communicating them clearly, and bringing other engineers along.
  • Instinct for when a problem deserves a central solution and when it should stay with the team that hit it.

Strongly preferred

  • Cloudflare (WAF, DNS, zero-trust/WARP) at production scale.
  • Datadog, JFrog, or comparable vendor integration experience.
  • Background in cost observability or FinOps tooling.
  • History of working on a platform team that serves internal customers — you understand the difference between running a platform and running a gate.

Your work will contribute to FERC's implementation of its first Equity Action Plan per Executive Order 13985.

The Executive Order on Advancing Racial Equity and Support for Underserved Communities Through the Federal Government, issued on January 20, 2021, aims to address systemic barriers and promote equal opportunity for underserved communities and individuals in the United States. The order emphasizes the importance of advancing equity, civil rights, racial justice, and equal opportunity across all federal agencies. It directs agencies to assess their programs and policies for perpetuating systemic barriers and develop strategies to deliver resources and benefits equitably to all. The order also establishes an interagency working group to gather and analyze data to inform efforts to measure and advance equity. Additionally, it revokes previous executive orders that were seen as hindering progress in this area.

We aspire to build and enhance an exceptional and diverse team of high-achievers who always put mission and the spirit of service first. At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is the leading software developer and solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. The Emergency Call Handling solution team is one business sleeve of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness.

Présentation du Département

Motorola Solutions est le leader dans le développement de logiciels et la fourniture de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence. Ces logiciels permettent aux centres 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres de réception des appels de sécurité publique (Public Safety Answering Points) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. L'équipe de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence constitue une branche clé de la division Software Enterprise de Motorola Solutions, où des innovations sont développées pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, au dispatch des intervenants, et à la surveillance situationnelle.

As a software developer, you will be joining a team developing a next generation 911 call handling solution that complies with industry standards and market demands, is capable of being deployed as a service or on-premises and meets high availability requirements our users have come to expect of 911 services. The team will utilize development talent across multiple design centers using Agile scrum methodology.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – BMaaS & Datacenter Networking
jobs.excerpt: About the TeamOur engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments.
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

Technical Qualifications

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Universal Requirements

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Educational & Experience Baseline

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintainership in open-source systems projects is a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

We’re looking for a Client Success Lead to own a portfolio of US and global accounts across entertainment, retail, and other sectors, and to grow it.

This is a commercial, quota-carrying role. What makes it different is what you’re selling. IP House protects some of the world’s most recognizable brands from counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement.   • Grow the accounts you hold. Identify expansion paths, lead the commercial conversations, and negotiate scope changes, uplifts, and renewals directly.

  • Work close to delivery. Partner with Operations to hold the line on timelines, quality, and compliance, and feed what you hear from clients back into Product and Client Solutions.
  • Represent IP House. Attend and speak at sector conferences and industry events as a business development presence.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 4–6 years in a quota-carrying role: sales, business development, or commercially accountable client success or account management.

  • Experience originating and closing net-new business, not only growing accounts you inherited.
  • Comfort owning pricing conversations, negotiating terms, and closing contracts.
  • Strong retention performance across a managed portfolio.
  • Disciplined pipeline and forecasting habits, and fluency with CRM.
  • Credibility with both commercial and operational audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Sector background in IP enforcement, brand protection, legal services, SaaS, or professional services is an advantage, but we’re more interested in commercial track record and the ability to learn a complex domain quickly.

Why IP House:

IP House helps brands, legal professionals, and rights holders manage and protect intellectual property online and offline, worldwide. We combine technology with deep domain expertise to deliver IP portfolio management, enforcement, and brand protection at scale.

With over 800 experts across five continents, we’re trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement.

Why Join:

You’ll have a defined market and the autonomy to build it, in a company that is scaling and where commercial performance is visible. We offer a flexible, remote-first working environment and a comprehensive benefits package covering health, well-being, and financial security for employees and their families.

jobs.title: Business Project Senior Advisor, Individual Dental Operations - Cigna Healthcare
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary The Business Project Senior Advisor leads complex business projects and operational initiatives across Individual Dental Operations.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Business Project Senior Advisor leads complex business projects and operational initiatives across Individual Dental Operations. This role is responsible for translating strategic priorities and business needs into structured project plans, coordinating execution across business, technology, vendor, and enterprise partners, and ensuring operational requirements are successfully implemented.

The Business Project Senior Advisor manages assigned initiatives from planning through implementation and stabilization. The role establishes project structure, clarifies scope and requirements, coordinates operational readiness, manages risks and dependencies, and provides transparent reporting to business leaders and stakeholders.

This position serves as a trusted project management advisor and senior individual contributor, supporting initiatives involving operational transformation, vendor implementation, customer experience, process improvement, regulatory change, and new or enhanced business capabilities.

Core Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Business Project and Program Leadership

  • Lead complex, cross-functional business projects from initial planning through execution, implementation, and operational stabilization.
  • Translate business objectives into defined project scope, deliverables, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans that provide clear visibility into activities, timing, ownership, and implementation readiness.
  • Coordinate execution across Operations, Technology, Product, Compliance, Finance, Vendor Management, Customer Experience, and other enterprise partners.
  • Maintain focus on intended business outcomes while adapting project plans to changing priorities, requirements, and operational conditions.
  • Provide structured leadership for initiatives that do not require a dedicated enterprise program-management resource but require disciplined business execution.

Project Planning, Governance, and Execution

  • Establish project governance practices appropriate to the size, complexity, risk, and strategic importance of each assigned initiative.
  • Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, decision forums, status reviews, and implementation-readiness discussions.
  • Maintain project documentation, including plans, status reports, action items, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and supporting business artifacts.
  • Monitor progress against established milestones and proactively identify conditions that may affect timing, scope, quality, cost, or operational readiness.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-functional issues and escalate matters requiring leadership direction or decisions.
  • Ensure project participants understand their responsibilities, deliverables, deadlines, and interdependencies.
  • Support post-implementation reviews to assess outcomes, capture lessons learned, and identify remaining stabilization needs.

Business Requirements and Operational Readiness

  • Partner with business owners and subject matter experts to identify, document, validate, and communicate business and operational requirements.
  • Help translate complex business needs into clear requirements that can be understood and acted upon by Technology, Product, vendor, and operational teams.
  • Coordinate operational-readiness activities involving procedures, training, communications, testing, controls, reporting, customer support, and implementation planning.
  • Confirm that operational impacts and readiness needs are identified early and incorporated into project plans.
  • Support the development of implementation, transition, contingency, and stabilization plans.
  • Coordinate with accountable business owners to confirm that required processes, resources, documentation, and support models are prepared for implementation.
  • Identify gaps between proposed solutions and operational needs and facilitate decisions regarding remediation or risk acceptance.

Vendor Implementation and Operational Coordination

  • Lead or support business projects involving vendor onboarding, transitions, new capabilities, service changes, and operational improvements.
  • Coordinate activities among internal business teams, vendor partners, Procurement, Technology, Finance, Compliance, and other responsible functions.
  • Incorporate vendor deliverables, dependencies, contractual milestones, and operational-readiness requirements into project plans.
  • Partner with Vendor Management and business owners to identify implementation risks, unresolved requirements, and potential service impacts.
  • Facilitate alignment between vendor-provided solutions and Individual Dental operational requirements.
  • Support vendor-related testing, training, documentation, communication, implementation, and stabilization activities.
  • Provide transparent reporting on vendor project progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions requiring attention.

Risk, Issue, Dependency, and Decision Management

  • Establish and maintain clear processes for identifying, documenting, evaluating, escalating, and monitoring project risks and issues.
  • Track project dependencies and evaluate how delays or changes in one workstream may affect other deliverables or operational outcomes.
  • Facilitate timely resolution of issues by clarifying ownership, required actions, target dates, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare decision materials that clearly present the business question, relevant facts, alternatives, risks, dependencies, and operational considerations.
  • Maintain project decision records that document approved direction and resulting impacts.
  • Escalate material risks, unresolved issues, scope conflicts, and missed commitments to the appropriate project sponsor or governance body.
  • Distinguish confirmed project information from estimates, assumptions, and items requiring validation.

Stakeholder Communication and Executive Reporting

  • Develop concise, accurate, and audience-appropriate project communications for business leaders, project teams, vendors, and enterprise partners.
  • Provide regular reporting on project health, delivery progress, upcoming milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Translate detailed project information into clear leadership summaries that focus on business impact and required action.
  • Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities, and levels of technical or operational knowledge.
  • Establish communication approaches that promote transparency, accountability, and timely decision-making.
  • Maintain effective working relationships across organizational boundaries and influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • Ensure material scope, schedule, requirement, or implementation changes are communicated to affected stakeholders.

Change Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Incorporate change-management principles into project planning and implementation activities.
  • Assess how proposed changes will affect employees, customers, business partners, workflows, tools, and operating procedures.
  • Coordinate with business leaders, Training, Communications, and operational teams to support adoption of new processes or capabilities.
  • Develop or support stakeholder assessments, communication plans, readiness activities, and transition approaches.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery practices, business workflows, governance, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Apply lessons learned from completed initiatives to strengthen future planning and execution.
  • Promote disciplined but practical project-management practices appropriate to the needs of a developing Individual Dental organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Advanced experience leading complex business projects, operational initiatives, implementations, or organizational change efforts.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects involving multiple business functions, stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities.
  • Experience developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, status reporting, risk and issue documentation, decision records, and implementation-readiness materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into clear requirements, deliverables, responsibilities, and execution plans.
  • Experience coordinating business, operational, technology, and vendor stakeholders through implementation and stabilization.
  • Strong understanding of business project management, operational readiness, risk management, change management, and process improvement.
  • Strong facilitation, organization, problem-solving, and decision-support skills.
  • Ability to identify emerging risks, evaluate potential business impacts, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-ready project updates and decision materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and establish accountability without direct reporting authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives and adjust priorities in a changing business environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project-planning, collaboration, or reporting tools.

Preferred

  • Project Management Professional, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or comparable professional certification.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, insurance, dental benefits, customer operations, or another regulated service environment.
  • Experience leading vendor onboarding, vendor transitions, sourcing implementations, or vendor-supported operational projects.
  • Experience serving as an Epic Owner, Business Project Manager, Program Manager, Agile Product Manager, or similar business delivery role.
  • Experience coordinating operational readiness across training, communications, procedures, testing, reporting, and business controls.
  • Experience supporting customer experience, digital, payment, communication, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Project Management, Operations, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Digital Brokerage & Investing Experience
jobs.excerpt: Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own.
jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help shape the future of investing at Empower by leading the evolution of our digital brokerage experience.

This role sits at the intersection of brokerage, equity compensation, and Empower’s broader financial ecosystem. In the near term, you will lead efforts to create a more connected and intuitive experience across Empower Personal Dashboard, our Stock Plan Services capabilities, and Pershing’s NetX Investor services. At the same time, you will play a key role in advancing Empower’s native brokerage experience, creating a modern investing experience that is increasingly integrated into the broader Empower ecosystem.

Our ambition is to make Empower a financial home base where customers can understand their complete financial picture, manage their workplace equity and investments, and take action with confidence, all through a cohesive digital experience.

You will bring deep knowledge of digital brokerage and Stock Plan Services experiences, strong product judgment, customer obsession, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership. You should understand both the complexity behind brokerage and equity compensation and what customers increasingly expect from modern investing experiences.

You will partner closely with our equity compensation product lead, engineering, design, research, operations, compliance, business leaders, and external brokerage and technology partners to simplify that complexity and create experiences customers want to use.

What You Will Do

  • Refine the vision and roadmap for Empower’s digital brokerage experience, spanning Stock Plan Services, existing brokerage capabilities, and the evolution toward a more cohesive native Empower investing experience.

  • Collaborate and define the product strategy for connecting Empower’s Personal Dashboard, Stock Plan Services via OptionTrax platform, and Pershing’s NetX Investor experiences as well as progressing our emerging native brokerage capabilities into intuitive customer journeys.

  • Identify opportunities to eliminate fragmentation across platforms and create a more seamless experience for customers moving between workplace equity, brokerage accounts, and their broader financial lives.

  • Help shape and build Empower’s next-generation brokerage capabilities, applying customer expectations and best practices from leading digital investing platforms while creating an experience differentiated by Empower’s broader financial ecosystem.

  • Own critical end-to-end experiences for stock plan participants, including equity awards, holdings, transactions, account experiences, and the transition from workplace equity into broader investing and wealth-building journeys.

  • Translate complex brokerage, equity compensation, operational, regulatory, and technology requirements into experiences that feel simple and intuitive to customers.

  • Partner with engineering, design, research, operations, compliance, and business teams from discovery through launch and ongoing optimization.

  • Partner effectively with external brokerage, clearing, custody, stock plan, and technology providers while maintaining ownership of the end customer experience.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs through qualitative research, usability testing, behavioral data, competitive research, and direct customer feedback.

  • Define and track measures of success across adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, transaction behavior, asset retention and consolidation, and overall digital experience.

  • Use experimentation, analytics, rapid validation, and customer feedback to test hypotheses and continuously improve the product.

  • Navigate the full product lifecycle—from defining the problem and product strategy through requirements, prioritization, delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.

  • Influence the longer-term investing strategy at Empower by identifying new capabilities and experiences that can make Empower a more valuable destination for customers' financial lives.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including significant experience building and leading complex digital consumer financial products.

  • Directly relevant experience with digital brokerage, Stock Plan Services, equity compensation, or investing products, with a strong understanding of the customer journeys and infrastructure that power these experiences.

  • Experience designing digital experiences for stock plan participants, including familiarity with equity awards and the lifecycle of employee equity compensation.

  • Strong understanding of brokerage customer experiences, including areas such as account opening, funding, positions and balances, trading, transactions, statements, servicing, and portfolio experiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify technically and operationally complex financial products into intuitive customer experiences.

  • Experience working across internal platforms and third-party providers to deliver an experience that feels cohesive to the end customer.

  • Proven experience owning the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and product strategy through execution, launch, measurement, and optimization.

  • Strong product judgment and an appreciation for excellent consumer product design, including the ability to distinguish between simply delivering functionality and creating an experience customers value.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and measure outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align engineering, design, business, operations, compliance, and other stakeholders around a product vision.

  • A strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to solve complex customer and business problems.

What Will Set You Apart

  • 3+ years of directly relevant experience building digital Stock Plan Services, brokerage, or investing experiences.

  • Experience building digital experiences for equity compensation products, including restricted stock, employee stock purchase plans, stock options, or similar programs.

  • Experience building or modernizing a direct-to-consumer brokerage experience, particularly across account opening, funding, trading, portfolio management, or brokerage servicing.

  • Experience integrating third-party brokerage, clearing, custody, or stock plan infrastructure while owning the customer-facing experience.

  • Experience bringing traditionally fragmented financial experiences together into a cohesive digital ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with the product patterns and customer expectations established by leading digital brokerage and investing platforms.

  • Experience operating in a regulated financial-services environment and partnering effectively with legal, risk, compliance, and operations teams.

  • Fintech experience and strong knowledge of emerging investing and brokerage trends.

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$114,000.00 - $165,300.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

Placement Specialist Overview

Are you looking for a role where you can be an independent worker, do meaningful work, contribute to team process, genuinely feel productive, and feel heard? If so, our Placement Specialist position at Keypath may be the next step in your career path.

At Keypath Education, our goal is to facilitate a student experience that best prepares students to enter their future career field with confidence. One of the ways we foster this experience is by providing placement services to students. As one of our Placement Team Members, you will assist students in achieving their dreams of being future leaders in their field. Talk about meaningful work!

What you’ll be doing as a Placement Specialist:

As a Placement Specialist you will spend your day forming relationships with the clinical placement sites where students can acquire hands-on learning in their field. This role is a hybrid between sales and customer service; Specialists will be responsible for introducing themselves to prospective providers and securing agreement to work with our students, while also providing quality follow-up to ensure a relationship that extends beyond the first placement. The goal is to ensure that each site is more than just a number and is, in fact, a mutually respected, cultivated relationship that continues to yield a quality student experience. Keeping this process personal grows the University's brand by sending prepared and engaged students to sites across the country. Our priority is always on the relationships built at the student, site, and university level.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Build partnerships with hospitals, community facilities/clinics and other agency sites for students to complete their clinical rotations in a variety if experiences across different specialties and present these sites to the Program Director for approval.
  • Develop leads for possible partnerships with healthcare agencies by identifying suitable clinical sites, negotiating placement agreements, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Manage relationships with existing clinical agency partners to ensure successful clinical experiences for all students.
  • Match students and site in a timely manner to avoid any lapse or delays in class registration.
  • Maintain complete knowledge and understanding of our Partners’ curriculum and programs and clearly explain these curricula and programs to clinical partners.
  • Identify and assess concerns related to clinical experiences; facilitate appropriate intervention with Placement Coordinators, faculty, and Program Coordinators.
  • Working with University Partners and legal teams to secure contracts with sites.
  • Serve as role model for faculty, staff, and students in the areas of customer service, collaboration, communication, and general professionalism.
  • Use relationship skills in situations requiring group problem solving, consensus building, and win-win negotiation.

Education:

The starting salary will fall somewhere in this range and will be determined by various factors such as experience, location, market conditions, and departmental budgets. You will have the opportunity to discuss your salary expectations during the interview process.

Keypath partners with SmartRecruiters and uses AI technology with SmartAssistant to efficiently screen, source, and match candidates using data and algorithms.

In joining our team, you also can enjoy a range of benefits designed to support your well-being and professional growth:

  • Embrace the flexibility of remote, hybrid, and flexible work options.
  • Access a competitive array of medical, vision, and dental insurance plans.
  • Take advantage of our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and various mental health and well-being support programs.
  • Invest in your future with our tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

  • Company-supported life and AD&D insurance, along with short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Inclusive parental leave programs designed to support you and your family.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued skills and experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Are you ready to join a team committed to making a meaningful impact on cancer treatment through the discovery and development of precision medicines? At Kura Oncology, you have an opportunity to be a part of something bigger, with a lasting impact that you can be proud of.

At Kura Oncology, we are working to change the paradigm and improve the science of cancer treatment. As an organization, we strive to cultivate a diverse and talented professional culture driven to develop precision medicine therapeutics.

As we continue to build a leading biotech organization with a strong culture, a patient-focused mindset and a team focused on relentless execution, we are looking for innovative, passionate professionals to join us and make our vision a reality.

To succeed at Kura, you will need to have a demonstrated ability for excellence in drug discovery and development and a roll-up your sleeves attitude. The ideal candidate will possess a values-driven work style where integrity and grit drive all behaviors, decisions, and actions.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

The Applications Administrator / IT Business Partner (ITBP) is responsible for managing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise technology applications while partnering with business functions to align technology capabilities with organizational strategy and operational priorities. This role reports to the Executive Director of IT and serves as both a technical application administrator and a strategic liaison between the IT organization and business stakeholders/operations.

In this capacity, the role ensures enterprise applications are effectively implemented, configured, maintained, and supported while also identifying opportunities for technology-driven improvements across the organization. The ITBP works collaboratively with stakeholders to translate business needs into technology solutions, ensuring systems, platforms, and digital initiatives deliver measurable value to the organization.

Application Management

jobs.title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren?
jobs.description:
Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt.

Wer wir sind

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop.

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt.

Warum diese Rolle

  • Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt.
  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.
  • Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt.
  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.
  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.
  • Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen.

Shop, Amazon & Brand

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern.
  • Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Produktion & Workflow

  • Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.
  • Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.
  • Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.
  • Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).
  • Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien.
  • Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst das visuelle Erscheinungsbild einer wachsenden Marke und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Inhouse-Creative-Produktion aktiv mit – inklusive KI-basierter Workflows.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Kontakt: Josephine Steuer

Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode und wir duzen uns einfach. Der Einfachheit halber verwenden wir im Text eine Sprachform, schließen damit aber ausdrücklich alle Menschen ein.

Since 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation. jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Lead
jobs.excerpt: The Threat Intelligence Lead will own Canonical’s threat intelligence strategy and execution, including understanding of which cyber threat actors are targeting Canonical, and the use of intelligence on Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTP) to better our products and internal cybersecurity controls.
jobs.description:
The Threat Intelligence Lead will own Canonical’s threat intelligence strategy and execution, including understanding of which cyber threat actors are targeting Canonical, and the use of intelligence on Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTP) to better our products and internal cybersecurity controls. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders as well as with the wider cybersecurity community, making sure that Canonical is recognised as a thought leader on open source threat intelligence.

This role will report to the CISO.

You will lead intelligence gathering and development activities on threat actors targeting software supply chains. You'll study attack trends across the wider open source software landscape, report findings to internal security teams, and advise the wider engineering community on the best course of action to detect and mitigate possible threats.

As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical products are directly or indirectly present in almost every organisation and household in the world, making them a prime target for threat actors. This team's mission is to help Canonical, and by extension countless community members and companies around the world, secure their software infrastructure.

What you’ll do in this role

  • Build and own Canonical’s threat intelligence strategy
  • Build and maintain OSINT research environments
  • Develop OSINT tradecraft, principals, and techniques
  • Identify and track targeted intrusion cyber threats, trends, and new developments by cyber threat actors through analysis of proprietary and open source datasets
  • Collaborate across teams to inform on activity of interest
  • Coordinate adversary/campaign tracking
  • Contribute to the wider threat intelligence community, establishing Canonical as a key contributor and thought leader in the space
  • Work with product and engineering teams to explain cybersecurity threats and advise on mitigation strategies
  • Work with the OPSEC and IS team to help implement/update security controls prioritising cyber defence
  • Identify intelligence gaps and propose new tools and research projects to fill them
  • Conduct briefings for executives, internal stakeholders and external customers

The successful Threat Intelligence Lead will be

  • An experienced threat intelligence leader (or similar)
  • Knowledgeable about the current open source threat landscape and computer networking/infrastructure concepts
  • Highly competent with OSINT tools (e.g., Buscador, Trace Labs OSINT VM, OSINT Framework, Maltego, Shodan, social media scraping tools, etc.)
  • Able to identify, organise, catalogue, and track adversary tradecraft trends — often with incomplete data
  • Experienced using threat intelligence data to influence enterprise architecture or product development decisions
  • An excellent communicator with the ability to clearly articulate and tailor technical content to a variety of audiences
  • Able to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Desired Characteristics

  • A professional portfolio of OSINT related scripts, tools, or frameworks
  • Demonstrated involvement in the larger OSINT community (please share relevant links)
  • Degree qualified, with a bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, or a related field
  • Certifications in related areas (e.g. GOSI, SANS SEC487 & SEC587, IntelTechniques OSIP, etc)
  • Experience in a tech company or government/military signal intelligence departments

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Position: Marketing Specialist (B2B) Position Type: Full-time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy) Reports to: Senior Manager, B2B Marketing Location: Toronto, ON (Remote) Division: Postmedia Integrated Advertising

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a Marketing Specialist (B2B) who will play a key role in supporting Postmedia’s SMB and National Agency marketing priorities. Working closely with the Content Marketing Specialist, Graphic Artist, Sales, and other stakeholders, you will help bring the Postmedia Solutions brand and go-to-market strategy to life across our owned digital channels, websites, social media platforms, and lead generation campaigns. This role is ideal for a hands-on marketer who understands how to take core content and transform it into targeted, multi-channel marketing assets that drive awareness, engagement, and demand. You will be responsible for distributing content created by the Content Marketing Specialist, developing social strategies and posts, creating lead magnets, and building website and landing page content that supports business growth across SMB and National Agency audiences.

Our ideal candidate must know how to:

  • Build strong relationships and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
  • Develop and execute marketing plans that support SMB and National Agency sales priorities.
  • Translate long-form content into engaging “liquid content” for different platforms, audiences, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Create compelling social media content, lead magnets, website pages, and landing pages.
  • Manage multiple projects while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understand how to distribute and promote content across websites, social media, email, and other digital channels.
  • Use performance insights to optimize content, campaigns, and channel strategy.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the market, competition, trends, and customer needs.

What you’ll do:

  • Support the execution of marketing strategies for Postmedia’s SMB and National Agency business.
  • Distribute content created by the Content Marketing Specialist across Postmedia websites, social media platforms, newsletters, and other owned channels.
  • Work with the Content Marketing Specialist and Graphic Artist to turn blog posts and long-form content into liquid content such as social posts, short-form copy, infographics, downloadable assets, email content, and promotional materials.
  • Develop and manage social media strategy and posting schedules for assigned business areas.
  • Create and publish social media content that supports awareness, engagement, lead generation, and sales enablement.
  • Build lead magnets such as guides, checklists, tip sheets, one-pagers, and other downloadable resources.
  • Create and update website pages and landing pages that support marketing campaigns, product priorities, and sales initiatives.
  • Ensure website and landing page content is clear, compelling, accurate, and optimized for conversion.
  • Partner with Sales to understand campaign needs, client priorities, and market opportunities.
  • Maintain and apply SEO/AEO/GEO best practices to website, landing page, and campaign content.
  • Support the execution of content calendars in alignment with strategic direction.
  • Ensure all marketing content is on brand and in the proper tone of voice for the target audience.
  • Track, measure, and report on campaign, content, website, landing page, and social media performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve content distribution, audience engagement, and lead generation.
  • Work within the Postmedia toolset: HubSpot, SEMRush, social publishing tools, WordPress.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years’ experience in marketing, digital marketing, social media, content marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting B2B marketing campaigns, preferably in media, advertising, digital marketing, or agency environments.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content adaptation skills.
  • Experience creating social media content and managing social posting schedules.
  • Experience building or supporting website pages, landing pages, lead magnets, and digital campaign assets.
  • Ability to turn long-form content into multiple short-form assets for different channels and audiences.
  • Self-starter attitude with excellent time management and project prioritization skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working with creative, sales, and cross-functional teams.
  • Customer-centric with a solid understanding of analytics and campaign performance.
  • Ability to work with AI platforms and marketing technology tools.

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Base Salary: $55,000 - $65,000
