jobs.excerpt: Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions.
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. 

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating automated solutions that streamline IT and business processes, reduce manual effort, and expand the organization's use of artificial intelligence and agentic workflows. This role bridges traditional scripting and infrastructure automation with modern AI-driven tooling, building systems that act, adapt, and scale with minimal human intervention.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in process automation, scripting, and workflow orchestration, and is actively exploring or applying AI and agentic technologies to solve real operational problems. This is a hands-on engineering role with high visibility and broad organizational impact. The ideal candidate brings specific experience working within highly regulated manufacturing industries. supporting data operations.

Key Responsibilities

Process & IT Automation

  • Identify, design, and implement automation solutions for repetitive IT and business processes across the organization.
  • Build and maintain automation scripts and workflows using Python and PowerShell, targeting infrastructure management, data movement, reporting, and operational tasks.
  • Develop and manage RPA (robotic process automation) workflows for business process automation where applicable.
  • Integrate automation solutions with enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, Azure, and third-party SaaS applications via APIs and connectors.
  • Document all automation solutions including design rationale, dependencies, failure modes, and runbooks.

AI & Agentic Workflow Development

  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI-powered automation tools, agentic frameworks, and large language model integrations within the organization.
  • Design and deploy agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar, enabling systems to reason, plan, and execute multi-step tasks autonomously.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing operational workflows to reduce manual decision-making and accelerate throughput.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high-value AI automation opportunities and translate them into production-ready solutions.
  • Evaluate and recommend AI tooling, platforms, and vendors in alignment with organizational security and compliance requirements.
  • Stay current on emerging agentic AI patterns, model capabilities, and automation frameworks; bring new approaches to the team proactively.

Workflow Orchestration & Integration

  • Design and manage end-to-end workflow orchestration using tools such as Apache Airflow, Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate, or similar platforms.
  • Build robust API integrations and event-driven automation pipelines across cloud and on-premises systems.
  • Implement error handling, retry logic, alerting, and observability for all automated workflows to ensure reliability and visibility.
  • Maintain and extend automation libraries and reusable components for use across teams.

Infrastructure & DevOps Automation

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for automated testing and deployment of automation artifacts.
  • Develop self-service automation tooling that enables non-engineers to trigger and monitor complex workflows safely.
  • Support cloud operations automation across Azure Government and AWS GovCloud environments.

Monitoring, Optimization & Support

  • Monitor automation health, execution logs, and failure rates; implement proactive alerting and self-healing where possible.
  • Perform root cause analysis on automation failures and implement durable fixes.
  • Continuously evaluate and optimize existing automation for performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on automation best practices across the Data & Analytics Division.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Partner with IT, data, cybersecurity, and business operations teams to identify and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Create and maintain thorough documentation for all automation solutions, including architecture diagrams, user guides, and compliance evidence.
  • Participate in sprint planning, architecture reviews, and cross-functional working groups.
  • Mentor team members on automation patterns, scripting best practices, and AI tooling adoption.

Technical Skills

Scripting & Programming (Required)

  • Expert level Python - scripting, automation, API integrations, AI/ML libraries (required)
  • Expert level PowerShell - infrastructure automation, Microsoft ecosystem scripting, task scheduling (required)
  • Bash / shell scripting - Linux and cross-platform automation tasks
  • REST API development and consumption - JSON, OAuth, webhook integrations

AI & Agentic Frameworks

  • Frameworks: LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent agentic orchestration frameworks
  • Platforms: Azure OpenAI Service, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Hugging Face
  • Patterns: prompt engineering, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), tool use / function calling, multi-agent coordination, memory and state management
  • Supporting: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search), embedding models, LLM evaluation frameworks

Workflow Orchestration & RPA

  • Apache Airflow - DAG design, scheduling, sensor patterns, dependency management
  • Azure Logic Apps / Power Automate - low-code workflow automation for Microsoft environments
  • Microsoft Power Platform - Power Automate, Power Apps, connectors
  • UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Power Automate Desktop - RPA tooling
  • Event-driven architecture - Azure Event Grid, Azure Service Bus, webhooks

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

  • Required: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation
  • Preferred: Ansible - configuration management and environment automation
  • CI/CD: Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions
  • Containers: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS) basics
  • Version control: Git - branching models, access management, code review workflows

Cloud Platforms

  • Azure Government / Microsoft 365: Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Azure Automation, Graph API, GCC High
  • AWS GovCloud: Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, S3, Systems Manager
  • Identity and access integrations: Entra ID (Azure AD), SCIM, OAuth 2.0, SAML

Monitoring & Observability

  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
  • Structured logging, alerting pipelines, and dashboard development
  • Self-healing automation patterns and failure-mode design

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field highly desired; or equivalent hands-on experience combined with certifications.
  • 12+ years of experience in automation engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and operating production-grade automation solutions at enterprise scale.
  • Hands-on experience designing or deploying AI-powered or agentic workflows in a professional setting.
  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments preferred.
  • US Person required, as defined under ITAR/EAR.

Soft Skills

  • Intellectually curious and self-directed - actively tracks and experiments with emerging AI and automation tooling.
  • Strong problem-solver who can move from ambiguous business need to working automation solution.
  • Clear communicator - able to explain automation capabilities and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits; treats automation artifacts as production software.
  • Collaborative and proactive - brings ideas to the team, not just execution.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate (AI-200)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
  • AWS Certified Developer - Associate
  • CompTIA Security+ (preferred for environments with compliance requirements)

Working Conditions

  • Fully remote position; no geographical preference.
  • Occasional after-hours availability for deployment windows and incident response.
  • Active participation in sprint-based delivery against a defined automation roadmap.
  • Must comply with all applicable data handling and export control policies.

The good faith base salary rangefor this role is$160,000–$180,000at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

jobs.excerpt: At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process.
jobs.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
We are seeking an experienced Director – Data Architect to provide architecture leadership across our Microsoft Data & AI practice.
This role will translate client business and technology priorities into scalable, secure, governed, and AI-ready data architectures using Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Databricks.

The ideal candidate combines deep Microsoft Data & AI architecture expertise, hands-on technical depth, and strong client-facing skills. This individual will lead architecture from discovery and solution design through implementation while helping clients modernize their data environments and enable Analytics, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

    Client & Technology Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted Data & AI architecture advisor to client business and technology stakeholders.
  • Lead client discovery and architecture workshops, translating business needs into executable Microsoft Data & AI architectures and modernization roadmaps.
  • Guide architecture decisions across Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or integrated Fabric + Databricks architectures based on client requirements and architectural fit.
  • Communicate architecture alternatives, trade-offs, risks, costs, and recommendations to executive and technical audiences.
  • Support presales activities including solution shaping, architecture development, technical presentations, estimation, proposals, and statements of work.
  • Collaborate with Microsoft architects, account teams, and technology specialists on strategic opportunities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects and engineering teams while maintaining sufficient hands-on depth to validate designs and guide implementation.

    • Data Architecture & Modernization

  • Define target-state Data & AI architectures, solution architectures, standards, and reusable design patterns leveraging the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Lead architecture for data modernization, cloud migration, analytics, and AI initiatives.
  • Architect modern lakehouse and data platform solutions using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure Databricks, ADLS, Delta Lake, and Power BI.
  • Define and implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) patterns for scalable ingestion, transformation, data quality, governance, and consumption.
  • Design architectures spanning batch and streaming ingestion, data transformation, integration, storage, semantic models, APIs, analytics, and AI consumption.
  • Establish strategies for data products, enterprise data models, semantic layers, metadata, lineage, data quality, and master/reference data.
  • Develop architecture patterns that balance scalability, security, performance, cost, maintainability, and speed-to-value.
  • Embed data governance, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, and data quality into architecture and solution designs.
  • Define governance patterns leveraging Microsoft Purview, Fabric governance capabilities, or Databricks Unity Catalog.
  • Promote governed and reusable enterprise data products rather than isolated project-specific datasets.

    • AI, Data Agents & Generative AI

  • Architect AI-ready data platforms supporting Generative AI, Agentic AI, and enterprise AI applications.
  • Design solutions leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric Data Agents, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, and AI agents.
  • Define patterns connecting governed enterprise data, semantic models, unstructured knowledge, AI models, and agents.
  • Establish approaches for grounding, AI evaluation, observability, security, MLOps/LLMOps, and production readiness.
  • Evaluate emerging Microsoft Data & AI capabilities and define practical enterprise adoption patterns.

What You'll Bring to the Role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years of technology experience, including significant experience in enterprise data platforms, cloud, analytics, and architecture.
  • 5+ years of architecture or senior technical leadership experience delivering large-scale enterprise data solutions.
  • Deep experience architecting Data & Analytics solutions on Microsoft Azure and defining target-state architectures and modernization roadmaps.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure Databricks, including OneLake, lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, data engineering, semantic models, and analytics.
  • Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture, data products, semantic layers, batch/streaming architectures, APIs, and event-driven integration.
  • Strong technical foundation in SQL, Python, Spark, distributed processing, data modeling, integration patterns, and APIs.
  • Strong understanding of Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Fabric Data Agents, Generative AI, RAG, vector search, and Agentic AI architectures.
  • Experience designing architectures supporting enterprise analytics, Power BI, AI/ML, Generative AI, and conversational access to enterprise data.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, data governance, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, and data quality.
  • Strong understanding of Azure security including Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, VNets, and Private Link/private endpoints.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into architecture decisions, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Experience with client discovery, presales solution architecture, estimation, technical presentations, and proposal development.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage client leaders, Microsoft stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams.
  • Relevant Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and/or Databricks certifications preferred.

Team Overview

For ten years in a row our Microsoft practice has achieved Microsoft's Inner Circle Award designation and we have been recognized as 'Partner of the year for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Service', ‘Partner of the year for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Marketing’ and as a Partner of the year finalist for ‘Intelligent Sales & Marketing’. In addition to our ongoing Gold Partner status, our competencies range from software development and deployment of Dynamics 365, to Power Platform, Azure and Microsoft 365. In mid-2022, the team was also named as one of only a handful of launch partners for the Microsoft D365 Contact Center.
Our integrated team approach of experienced CX engineers, developers, data scientists, and solution architects, design, deploy and support complex and fully integrated digital solutions that are focused on creating an exceptional customer experience.

About Us

Avtex is now TTEC Digital. The acquisition aligns to TTEC’s continued focus on fueling experience transformations. Our deep expertise in the most innovative and disruptive brands in the digital industry enables our clients to provide amazing customer experiences.
TTEC Digital, and our 1,700+ employees, pioneer engagement and growth solutions that fuel the exceptional customer experience (CX). TTEC Engage is a 60,000+ employee service company, with customers in more than 80 countries. Together, we utilize a holistic approach, applying solutions from two centers of excellence, Engage and Digital.
TTEC is a proud equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability. TTEC has fully embraced and is committed to expanding our diverse and inclusive workforce. We strive to reflect the communities we serve while delivering amazing service and technology centered around humanity.

Our engagements aim to eliminate obstacles, reduce risk, and accelerate timelines for customers transitioning to Google and seeking assistance with data and application modernization. We embed within customer teams to provide strategic guidance, facilitate technology decisions, and execute projects in a collaborative, co-development style.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will work closely with fast-paced, innovative companies where cloud is a key driver of transformation.

You’ll be expected to operate across a wide range of topics, including infrastructure, networking, application architecture, and modernization — not just CI/CD or tooling.

  • Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure in Google Cloud
  • Migrate applications from on-premise environments or other cloud providers (AWS, Azure) to GCP
  • Work on application modernization using containers, Kubernetes, and serverless technologies
  • Troubleshoot complex systems across infrastructure, networking, databases, and applications
  • Collaborate directly with customer teams to guide architecture and technical decisions
  • Build automation and infrastructure as code using modern tooling
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

jobs.excerpt: About CircleCI EngineeringCI/CD has been solved.  Now it's being reinvented.
jobs.description:
About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

Team-Agnostic Placement

We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
  • Own technical strategy for your domain. You decide when and how the architecture evolves, balancing technical debt against velocity. When a project spans teams, you're the one who breaks down the ambiguity and takes ownership of whether it lands.
  • Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on.
  • Own the full stack, at scale. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. Your ownership extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.
  • Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.
  • Champion observability. Drive monitoring and alerting strategy across your domain, not just your own services. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to reduce noise and improve the org's ability to diagnose problems quickly.
  • Mentor at scale. Mentor multiple engineers at once. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own.

What You'll Bring

  • AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.
  • A track record of shipping at scale. You've built and owned systems that other engineers build on. 8+ years of production full-stack experience, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Full-stack depth. Strong across the stack — React and TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, owning API design, data modeling, and service integration.
  • System design, across domains. You own architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams. You make the tradeoff calls, document the reasoning, and are the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious.
  • Business acumen. You understand how your domain connects to the broader business, and you use that context to guide technical decisions, not just implement them.
  • Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

jobs.excerpt: About UsDo you think Artificial Intelligence is changing the world?
jobs.description:
About Us

Do you think Artificial Intelligence is changing the world? So do we.

At Gemmo, we don’t just build models: we help Fortune 200 companies like Novartis and Broadridge harness the power of AI to generate real, measurable impact. We are a Machine Learning and Computer Vision startup founded in 2020, headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with an AI Lab in Milan, Italy.

Our expertise spans Machine Learning and Generative AI for financial services and Computer Vision for life sciences. We build custom AI solutions that combine automation with human insight — first exploring the highest-impact opportunities, then designing and deploying tailored solutions, and finally helping improve and maintain them over time. We believe in responsible, pragmatic AI: systems that integrate into real workflows, provide measurable value, and remain under your control.

Our Team

  • Machine Learning & Engineering: 14 people, including 2 Ph.D.s
  • Business & Strategy: 3 people
  • Leadership: 2 people

A lean, technical-first team — and we’re growing. We’re looking to add 5 new tech roles before the end of the year.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Azure Cloud Architect to own cloud infrastructure design and delivery for our financial services engagements. This is an individual contributor role with real client exposure: you will work directly with technical stakeholders at client organisations, translate complex requirements into sound architectural decisions, and be accountable for the quality of what gets built and deployed.

You will work closely with our engineering team to ensure that AI-driven platforms are backed by infrastructure that is secure, scalable, and fit for regulated environments.

What You Will Do

Design and document end-to-end cloud architectures on Azure for financial services clients, taking ownership of service selection, cost optimisation, and compliance considerations.

Act as the primary technical point of contact with client engineering and infrastructure teams, leading architecture discussions and translating business requirements into concrete technical plans.

Work alongside ML engineers and backend developers to ensure that AI workloads, data pipelines, and APIs are deployed on infrastructure that meets enterprise and regulatory requirements.

Contribute to technical proposals and scoping documents for new client engagements, providing credible architectural estimates and risk assessments.

Identify and resolve infrastructure risks across active projects, particularly where data governance, latency, or compliance constraints are involved.

Tech Stack

  • Cloud: Azure
  • Languages: Python, TypeScript, SQL
  • Data: Snowflake, Postgres
  • APIs and services: OpenAI, Anthropic
  • Engineering practices: Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, infrastructure as code

What We're Looking For

Proven experience designing and delivering production Azure architectures, ideally within financial services or other regulated industries.

Strong grasp of security, compliance, and data governance requirements in enterprise cloud environments.

Comfort working directly with senior client stakeholders: you can run an architecture review, explain trade-offs clearly, and push back when necessary.

Familiarity with AI and ML workloads is a plus, but cloud architecture is the primary competence we are hiring for.

How We Work

Two short daily standups, weekly sprints, and a Friday retrospective. Everything else is async: documentation on Linear and GitHub, communication on Slack.

Working Arrangements

This role is fully remote from anywhere in Italy. Occasional travel to client sites or our Milan office should be expected.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30 CET.

Selection Process

We keep it fast and transparent, with a total timeline of three to four weeks.

  • Initial interview with CTO or Senior Engineer (15 minutes): company and role presentation, alignment on expectations.
  • Technical interview (60 minutes): architecture discussion, Azure design scenarios, and reasoning through real financial services constraints.
  • Interview with CEO (30 minutes): final alignment on vision, culture, and direction.

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on cloud architecture experience, with Azure as the primary platform
  • Familiarity with Snowflake
  • Proven delivery of production-grade Azure infrastructure for enterprise clients
  • Direct experience working with client technical stakeholders: architecture reviews, requirement translation, and written design documentation
  • Strong grasp of security, compliance, and data governance requirements in regulated cloud environments
  • Comfortable reasoning about trade-offs across cost, scalability, latency, and compliance, and communicating those trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Fluent in infrastructure as code and modern engineering practices: CI/CD, Git workflows, automated testing
  • Professional English required; Italian is a strong plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated industries (capital markets, insurance, banking)
  • Exposure to AI or ML workloads in production
  • Background in consulting or professional services, where you have owned client relationships alongside technical delivery

Benefits

Compensation

  • RAL : €50'000 to €60'000
  • Project bonuses: awarded on delivery and client impact (min 4 projects / year)
  • Year-end bonus: awarded for team performance
  • Annual salary review
  • +10% salary progression at each career level

Benefits

  • A brand new MacBook Pro M5 14”
  • Once a year, the whole team flies to Dublin for a 3-day offsite at our HQ
  • 20 days of paid holiday per year, 8 public holidays, and 104 hours of additional permitted leave per year

jobs.title: Customer Education Lead
jobs.excerpt: At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner. Our product, CoLab, is the world’s first Design Engagement System (DES) - a category defining product that Engineering teams use to engage in meaningful, productive design conversations, catch preventable mistakes, and get to market faster. Our customers include the largest engineering organizations in the world such as Ford, Johnson Controls, Komatsu, and Polaris in the industrial equipment, consumer products, automotive, aerospace & defense, and shipbuilding industries.

We’re building a world-class customer education program to help every customer adopt faster, achieve measurable outcomes, and renew with confidence. This is a foundational role of that function.

The Customer Education Lead will design and deliver scalable learning experiences that extend the reach of our Customer Success team, accelerate time-to-value, and create consistent, high-quality enablement across our customer base. You'll partner closely with Product (who owns in-product experience), Customer Success (who understand customer pain points and workflows), our Implementation Specialist (who delivers hands-on onboarding and sees firsthand where customers struggle), and Marketing (who own brand voice and external content) to build an education infrastructure that supports the entirety of our customer base from first login to advanced use cases.

You'll also be standing up CoLab Academy, designing the certifications, learning paths, and resources that make our customers confident, self-sufficient users from day one.

What You'll Do

Understand your learners

  • Map CoLab's distinct customer audiences and identify what each group needs to learn, when, and how
  • Use product usage data, support ticket trends, and CSM feedback to pinpoint where customers get stuck and where education can have the highest impact
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers, Solutions Engineers, and the Implementation Specialist to translate real-world customer friction into learning priorities

Design & Build Scalable Learning Experiences

  • Create customer-facing onboarding and enablement materials (videos, guides, templates, self-paced modules)
  • Design interactive learning paths for end-users
  • Translate complex product workflows into clear, actionable resources
  • Build assessments to check comprehension and certification exams to validate mastery of knowledge and skills
  • Develop CoLab Academy curriculum (certifications, learning paths, use case guides)

Stand up the education infrastructure

  • Evaluate, select, and implement a learning management system (LMS) or content hub that supports self-serve learning, progress tracking, and completion reporting
  • Define repeatable content creation, review, and maintenance processes — including version control and a release-aligned update cadence so materials stay current as the product ships new features
  • Build feedback loops between learners, CSMs, and Product so content improves continuously
  • Identify opportunities to complement formal education with peer learning: how other companies use CoLab for design review, what configurations work for different industries, workflows for various teams
  • Lay the groundwork for customer community and knowledge-sharing programs as the education function matures
  • Partner with the Implementation Specialist to define what gets delivered 1:1 in live implementations vs. what gets built as self-serve education and evolve that over time as the content library matures

Accelerate Time-to-Value

  • Partner with CSMs, Product, and the Implementation Specialist to identify high-friction onboarding points and address them through education
  • Measure the impact of content on customer health, user activation, feature adoption, and renewal outcomes and Iterate based on data

Enable Customer Success & Go-to-Market Teams

  • Equip CSMs and CSEs with ready-to-use materials to drive consistent messaging and reduce 1:1 training time
  • Create internal enablement content on new features and use cases (if we're teaching customers, we should enable our teams too)
  • Partner with Product Marketing on key feature launches, ensuring education content is ready at release

What We're Looking For

Must have:

  • 3+ years in instructional design, customer education, or enablement at a B2B SaaS company
  • Experience creating customer-facing content that drives measurable adoption
  • Demonstrated success linking education programs to business outcomes (adoption, time-to-value, renewals)
  • Strong project management and collaboration skills across Customer Success, Product, and Marketing
  • Excellent writing, organization, and presentation skills

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with technical B2B products, especially engineering tools (CAD, PLM, DevOps, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with LMS platforms (e.g., Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries) or course authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Rise, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite)
  • Proven ability to design for scale, blending asynchronous and live learning formats
  • Background in customer marketing, enablement, or customer community

You’ll Thrive at CoLab If You

  • Are energized by building systems from scratch and bringing clarity to ambiguity
  • Are passionate about helping people learn, adopt, and succeed
  • See education as a strategic lever for customer and business outcomes
  • Love partnering cross-functionally and connecting dots between Product, Success, and Marketing
  • Are motivated by measurable impact: you care about activation, usage, and renewal metrics

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. jobs.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products. These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility.

As a Microsoft Partner with nine specializations, GitHub AI Partner of the Year, a member of the GitHub Advisory Board, and a member of the prestigious Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), Atmosera expertly delivers cutting-edge, integrated solutions that deliver business value.

You are joining us to own the technical vision and architecture for our shared, multi-tenant technology platforms. Your day-to-day will involve designing and validating Azure-based solutions, decomposing complex initiatives into scoped work your team can execute independently, and partnering with business and account stakeholders to make sure what gets built maps to real client and operational needs — all aimed at strengthening the reliability, security, and scalability of the platforms our business runs on.

Required Skills

    • 8+ years of cloud engineering and architecture experience.

    • Role-Specific Mastery — Deep, intimate knowledge of Microsoft Azure — its monitoring, automation, and platform services — with strong experience designing cloud solutions and validating approaches through focused, time-boxed spikes.

    • Operational Excellence — Demonstrated ability to break down complex, ambiguous work into scoped, delegable pieces and lead delivery through others; hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code (Bicep or Terraform) and scripting (PowerShell, Python).

    • Communication — Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to engage and influence in business-facing and cross-functional conversations with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Collaboration — Experience partnering with cross-functional and account teams to surface technical considerations early and help shape what gets built and why.

    • Problem Solving — A pattern-oriented mindset — able to generalize individual requests into reusable solutions — along with working knowledge of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL to strengthen platform observability

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Multi-Tenant / MSP Experience — Experience supporting multiple clients or tenants from a shared platform.

    • Security & Compliance — Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to managed cloud services, including Microsoft Sentinel.

    • CI/CD — Experience with CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.

    • Certifications — Relevant Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

What Success Looks Like

    We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a "win" for this role over your first year:

    After 90 Days

    • The Foundation — You have developed deep familiarity with the current platform architecture, active technical initiatives, and existing pain points across the environment.

    • The Integration — You have built strong working relationships with Engineering and Cloud Operations, and are engaging confidently in cross-functional and business-facing conversations.

    • The Contribution — You have completed your first scoped architectural spike or initiative, documented your findings, and handed off clear, well-defined work to engineers.

    After 1 Year

    • Your Impact — Platform reliability, security posture, and observability have measurably improved, including elevated monitoring and telemetry practices across the environment.

    • Your Growth — You have mentored engineers on Azure architecture best practices and are recognized as the go-to technical authority for the platform.

    • Your Influence — You have established reusable architectural patterns and evaluated AI-assisted development practices that improved team velocity and delivery quality

How We Show Up

    These 'Core Three' represent the heartbeat of Atmosera. They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best.

    • Humble (Low Ego, High Impact) — We share credit easily, admit when we're wrong, and view every mistake as a data point for growth.

    • Hungry (Internal Drive) — We have a natural bias for action. We don't wait for permission to solve a problem or find a better way to do things.

    • Mindful (Intentional Awareness) — We are conscious of our impact on the team. We listen more than we speak and respond to challenges with empathy and situational awareness.

Our Interview Process

    We value your time and aim for transparency. Our typically interviews look like this:

    1. Talent Screen: (30 mins) A conversation about your background and the role mission.

    2. The Impact & Attributes Assessment: (45 mins) Values-based Interview (Cultural DNA and The Core Three).

    3. Collaborator Loop: (60-90 mins) The "What" (Required Skills and Core Capabilities). This stage may require a presentation or work sample.

    4. Final Alignment: (30 mins) Closing conversation with Leadership.

jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, Machine Learning, you will build core ML components. You will work on real production systems from day one, learning how large-scale ML behaves outside of research settings.

This role is for engineers who want to develop strong systems judgment by shipping, debugging, and iterating on real-world ML.

Focus

  • Build and improve ML components across data, training, evaluation, and inference.

  • Fine-tune and adapt models as part of larger production systems.

  • Implement evaluation and testing to understand model behavior.

  • Help build and maintain data pipelines for real-world and synthetic data.

  • Debug model issues, performance problems, and production incidents.

  • Ship improvements iteratively and learn from real user feedback.

  • Work closely with senior ML engineers and product teams.

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Production ML systems running on GPUs

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Some hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and learning new tools quickly.

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn from real systems in production.

  • Able to work through ambiguity with guidance and grow ownership over time.

  • Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement.

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, latency, and reliability targets.

  • Production issues are identified quickly, debugged effectively, and root causes addressed.

  • Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are robust, reproducible, and maintainable.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineers, product, and research teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

  • Iterations on models and systems are driven by real-world signals and measurable improvements.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.
